SaveName: Attack Wing Remodulated - AI Anticipation 19 Oct 2026

0.title: Rules
0.body:
[Comming Soon]
A simple version of the rules as found in the Star Trek Attack Wing rulebook that comes with the base set.

1.title: Auto Movement
1.body:
On either side of the player, boards are a number of control panels. To use them simply import your fleet into the table as normal. For each ship in your build place that model onto of the control Panel you with to use for that ship. Then click 'SYNC" sync 

If you do not have that model placed on the Contol Panel then you will get an error message. Also if you click a command on a board that does not have a ship assigned to it you will get an error message. I suggest deleting any unused boards. Each side has 4 but you can add more simply by copy-paste.

3.title: STA2E 0.8 Guide
3.body:
GALAXY GRID ALIGNMENT

The open dial now follows the maneuver chart printed on the Galaxy Class S274 card.

Speed 1: 1 BL | 1 FWD | 1 BR, with 1 REV in the right margin.
Speed 2: 2 BL | 2 FWD | 2 BR, with 2 REV in the right margin.
Speed 3: 3 TL | 3 BL | 3 FWD | 3 BR | 3 TR across all five chart columns.
Speed 4: 4 FWD centered.
Speed 5: 5 FWD centered.

The maneuver buttons are narrower, shorter and more transparent so the printed grid remains visible. Open/Close Dial persistence, the enlarged cards, Open Play behavior and the supplied standard-base mesh remain unchanged.

4.title: Alliance AI Prototype
4.body:
ALLIANCE AI PROTOTYPE v0.4 — based on Remodulated _v6

SETUP
Import fleets and deploy ships through the existing Red/Blue setup. A solo player can import both friendly and enemy fleets under their own seat (use separate fleet IDs).
Click AI CONTROL: OFF on each enemy ship card to enable it. Player ships default to Allied; enabled AI ships default to Enemy. Ship controls are shared across players. Ownership still identifies fleets and token colors. Player maneuver selection stays hidden until reveal; AI panels are public.
AI bases are named AI — [ship name]. Open the ship dial to see the AI panel. AI ships are excluded from the player planning lock requirement.

PLAYTEST
Choose Engage, Chase, or Escape. During Activation, click Evaluate, inspect its target and resolved maneuver, then Execute. Execute requires a fresh evaluation if either ship moved or the selected target changed. Pick a normal action manually after movement, or Finish. Red maneuvers remove one tagged Aux token, if present, and skip the normal action. Add Aux through the AI panel or ship token controls so it is linked to that ship. Undo restores movement/state and an Aux token removed by red recovery. Manually selected action tokens still need manual cleanup if you undo after taking an action.

MOVEMENT LANGUAGE
Slowest / Middle / Fastest refer to available speeds for that bearing and direction. Middle selects the lower middle for an even number of options. Missing bearing fallback: Come About > Reverse > Turn > Bank > Straight; fallback speeds are fastest first. Come About requests currently use Fastest. Dial color does not filter selection; red controls recovery/action skipping.

TARGETING AND GEOMETRY
Target selection: enemies within Range 3, lowest occupied zone, then closest base-edge distance. Exact ties use stable ship identity. Overlapping bases count as Range 1 for the lookup.
Zone 1: corridor extending forward from the base, one base-width wide. Zone 2: forward shoulders out to 45 degrees from the front corners. Zone 3: remaining sides ahead of the rear edge. Zone 4: behind the rear edge. These boundaries are a first-pass interpretation of the supplied diagram.
Target aspect uses its facing: Front is a 90-degree forward sector; Port/Starboard are side sectors. Port and Starboard flank sectors wrap fully around the rear; exactly aft uses Port as a deterministic boundary tie.
Toward uses the corrected Port/Starboard mapping from the vector playtest (reversed from v0.1). Its reference is the nearest point on the target's heading/course line. This is a prototype interpretation of the vector sketch. AUTO VECTOR calculates it; TOWARD = PORT / STBD lets you override it for testing. Away reverses that direction. Exact alignment requires an override when a directional move is requested.

LIMITS
With no enemy within Range 3, the AI targets board center (x=0, z=0) using Approaching/Front entries. Center distance uses base-edge measurement and is capped at Range 3 for the existing table. Once an enemy enters Range 3, Evaluate prioritizes that enemy again. The 36-situation behavior table is a draft, with Middle trialled for Range 2 flank chase in Zones 1/2. Intent and normal action selection are manual. Combat and campaign automation are not included. This controller assumes the front/flank geometry discussed; special ship movement families beyond the fallback chain need later behavior profiles.
Existing movement execution still handles ship overlaps and terrain. No hidden player maneuver is read.

VALIDATION
JSON, Lua compilation, panel XML, and mocked Lua behavior checks passed. Live TTS loading, visual placement, and physical movement still require an in-game playtest.

v0.2: corrected Toward/Away direction; shared ship, upgrade, and AI controls; private player planning/locked dials; shared revealed controls and public AI panels.


v0.3: mirrored Left/Right at the AI chart-to-dial lookup, including Turn/Bank fallbacks. Player movement templates, vector classification, shared controls, and dial privacy retain v0.2 behavior.


v0.4: Flanks wrap around the rear. No nearby enemy -> Board Center, Approaching/Front. Center maneuver direction uses the center bearing; exact alignment uses a fixed side if needed. Evaluate/Execute invalidates a center plan when a nearby enemy becomes available.

MEMBER_SCRIPT = [===[-- STA2E 0.5: visible physical controls and persistent component identity.
memory = {}
display = {dialOpen=false}
function onLoad(saved)
    if saved and saved ~= "" then
        local ok, value = pcall(JSON.decode, saved)
        if ok and type(value) == "table" then memory = value end
    end
    if memory.role == "model" then self.interactable = false; self.setLock(true) end
    STA2E_DrawButtons()
    Wait.frames(function() Global.call("STA2E_Register", {object=self}) end, 2)
end
function onSave() return JSON.encode(memory) end
function STA2E_SetMemory(value)
    memory = value
    self.script_state = JSON.encode(memory)
    STA2E_DrawButtons()
end
function STA2E_SetDisplay(value)
    display = value or {dialOpen=false}
    STA2E_DrawButtons()
end
function STA2E_UI(player, value, id)
    Global.call("STA2E_Command", {object=self, color=player.color, command=id})
end
function STA2E_DialHoverEnter(player,value,id)
    Global.call("STA2E_DialHover",{object=self,color=player.color,id=id,enter=true})
end
function STA2E_DialHoverExit(player,value,id)
    Global.call("STA2E_DialHover",{object=self,color=player.color,id=id,enter=false})
end
function STA2E_CardMenu(player, value, id)
    Global.call("STA2E_Command", {object=self, color=player.color, command=id})
end
local function send(color, command)
    Global.call("STA2E_Command", {object=self, color=color, command=command})
end
local function add(callback, label, x, z, width, color, height, fontSize, underside)
    self.createButton({function_owner=self,click_function=callback,label=label,
        position={x,underside and -0.28 or 0.28,z},rotation=underside and {0,0,180} or {0,0,0},
        width=width or 240,height=height or 92,font_size=fontSize or 42,color=color or {0.12,0.28,0.42,0.82},font_color={1,1,1},tooltip=label})
end
local function addBoth(callback, label, x, z, width, color, height, fontSize)
    add(callback,label,x,z,width,color,height,fontSize,false)
    add(callback,label,x,z,width,color,height,fontSize,true)
end
local lastButtonSignature=nil
function STA2E_DrawButtons()
    local state=memory.state or {}
    local signature=table.concat({tostring(memory.role),tostring(state.dialOpen==true),tostring(memory.ai and memory.ai.enabled==true),tostring(display.guideArc==true)},"|")
    if signature==lastButtonSignature then return end
    lastButtonSignature=signature
    self.clearButtons()
    if memory.role == "card" then
        -- Ship card controls are on the physical front face only.
        local dialOpen=memory.state and memory.state.dialOpen==true
        add("STA2E_Deploy","DEPLOY",-0.68,-1.78,390,{0.08,0.38,0.25,0.88})
        add("STA2E_OpenDial",dialOpen and "CLOSE DIAL" or "OPEN DIAL",0,-1.78,390,{0.12,0.28,0.42,0.88})
        add("STA2E_Actions","ACTIONS",0.68,-1.78,390,{0.38,0.28,0.08,0.88})
        add("STA2E_AI","AI CONTROL: "..((memory.ai and memory.ai.enabled) and "ON" or "OFF"),0,-2.18,1000,{0.25,0.35,0.48,0.88},82,34)
        add("STA2E_Settings","SHIP CONTROLS",0,-2.52,1000,nil,82,34)
    elseif memory.role == "upgrade" or memory.role == "fleetCard" then
        addBoth("STA2E_Manage","MANAGE",0,-1.55,330,{0.12,0.28,0.42,1},80,34)
    elseif memory.role == "base" or memory.role == "baseModel" then
        add("STA2E_Arc",display.guideArc and "CLEAR" or "ARC",-0.48,0.78,240,nil,80,34,false)
        add("STA2E_Range","RANGE",0.48,0.78,240,nil,80,34,false)
        add("STA2E_AIArcs","AI SECTORS",0,1.12,480,nil,80,30,false)
    elseif memory.role == "dial" then
        -- Maneuver controls use color-scoped XML assembled by Global.
        -- Physical buttons cannot keep a planned maneuver secret.
    end
end
function STA2E_Deploy(_,color) send(color,"deploy") end
function STA2E_OpenDial(_,color) send(color,"open_dial") end
function STA2E_AI(_,color) send(color,"ai_toggle") end
function STA2E_Actions(_,color) send(color,"toggle_actions") end
function STA2E_Arc(_,color) send(color,"quick_arc") end
function STA2E_Range(_,color) send(color,"quick_range") end
function STA2E_AIArcs(_,color) send(color,"quick_ai_arcs") end
function STA2E_Settings(_,color) send(color,"ship_settings") end
function STA2E_Manage(_,color) Global.call("STA2E_ManageCard",{object=self,color=color}) end
function STA2E_Lock(_,color) send(color,"lock") end
function STA2E_Change(_,color) send(color,"change") end
function STA2E_Reveal(_,color) send(color,"reveal") end

CLOAK_TOKEN_SCRIPT = [===[local menuOpen=false
local function add(callback,label,x,z,width,height,fontSize,underside)
    self.createButton({function_owner=self,click_function=callback,label=label,position={x,underside and -0.34 or 0.34,z},rotation=underside and {0,0,180} or {0,0,0},width=width,height=height,font_size=fontSize,color={0.08,0.18,0.28,0.94},font_color={1,1,1},tooltip=label})
end
local function draw()
    self.clearButtons()
    -- Large edge control: intentionally about four times the old dimensions.
    add("STA2E_Toggle","ECHO",0,0.72,720,560,220,false);add("STA2E_Toggle","ECHO",0,0.72,720,560,220,true)
    if menuOpen then
        add("STA2E_Echo","SENSOR ECHO",-0.48,-0.12,820,300,125,false);add("STA2E_Echo","SENSOR ECHO",-0.48,-0.12,820,300,125,true)
        add("STA2E_Toggle","X",0.72,-0.12,220,300,150,false);add("STA2E_Toggle","X",0.72,-0.12,220,300,150,true)
    end
end
function onLoad() draw() end
function STA2E_Toggle() menuOpen=not menuOpen;draw() end
function STA2E_Echo(_,color)
    local instance=self.getGMNotes():match("^STA2E_SHIP_TOKEN|([^|]+)|CLK$")
    Global.call("STA2E_StartSensorEcho",{color=color,instanceId=instance,source=self,sourceType="cloak"})
end
]===]

local function copy(value) return JSON.decode(JSON.encode(value)) end
local function decode(text)

    return nil

local function xml(text)
    return tostring(text or ""):gsub("&", "&"):gsub('"', """):gsub("<", "<"):gsub(">", ">")
end
local function defaultXmlAttribute(markup,tag,attribute,value)
    local needle="<"..tag.." ";local output={};local cursor=1
    while true do
        local first,last=markup:find(needle,cursor,true)
        if not first then table.insert(output,markup:sub(cursor));break end
        table.insert(output,markup:sub(cursor,first-1))
        local close=markup:find(">",last+1,true)
        if not close then table.insert(output,markup:sub(first));break end
        local node=markup:sub(first,close)
        if not node:find(" "..attribute.."=",1,true) then node=needle..attribute..'="'..value..'" '..node:sub(#needle+1) end
        table.insert(output,node);cursor=close+1
    end
    return table.concat(output)
end

    local common={TL="Left Turn",BL="Left Bank",S="Straight",BR="Right Bank",TR="Right Turn",CA="Come About",FAL="Full About Left",FAR="Full About Right",IRL="Impulse Roll Left",IRR="Impulse Roll Right",R="Reverse"}
    if common[prefix] then return common[prefix]..(n and (" "..n) or "") end
    if prefix=="GL" or prefix=="GR" then return "Borg "..(prefix=="GL" and "L" or "R")..tostring(n or "") end
    if prefix=="SL" or prefix=="SR" then return "Borg Spin "..(prefix=="SL" and "Left " or "Right ")..tostring(n or "") end
    if prefix=="EcoL" or prefix=="EcoR" then return "Evasive "..(prefix=="EcoL" and "Left " or "Right ")..tostring(n or "") end
    local station={STOP0="Station Stop",ROTL0="Station Rotate Left",ROTR0="Station Rotate Right",PIVOTL0="Station Pivot Left",PIVOTR0="Station Pivot Right",DL1="Station Drift Left 1",DR1="Station Drift Right 1",DL2="Station Drift Left 2",DR2="Station Drift Right 2"}
    return station[key] or general[key] or fallback or tostring(key or "Unknown")
end
local function maneuverFamily(key)
    local prefix=tostring(key or ""):match("^([A-Za-z]+)") or ""
    if prefix=="TL" or prefix=="BL" or prefix=="S" or prefix=="BR" or prefix=="TR" or prefix=="CA" or prefix=="FAL" or prefix=="FAR" or prefix=="IRL" or prefix=="IRR" or (prefix=="R" and key~="R180") then return MANEUVER_FAMILY_ORDER[prefix] end
    if prefix:match("^Eco") then return MANEUVER_FAMILY_ORDER.ECO end
    if prefix=="GL" or prefix=="GR" or prefix=="SL" or prefix=="SR" then return MANEUVER_FAMILY_ORDER.BORG end
    if prefix=="STOP" or prefix=="ROTL" or prefix=="ROTR" or prefix=="PIVOTL" or prefix=="PIVOTR" or prefix=="DL" or prefix=="DR" then return MANEUVER_FAMILY_ORDER.STATION end
    return MANEUVER_FAMILY_ORDER.GENERAL
end
local function orderedManeuvers(values)
    local result={}
    for _,value in ipairs(values or {}) do table.insert(result,value) end
    table.sort(result,function(a,b)
        local ak=type(a)=="table" and a.key or a
        local bk=type(b)=="table" and b.key or b
        local af,bf=maneuverFamily(ak),maneuverFamily(bk)
        if af~=bf then return af<bf end
        local as=tonumber(tostring(ak):match("(%d+)$")) or 0
        local bs=tonumber(tostring(bk):match("(%d+)$")) or 0
        if as~=bs then return as<bs end
        return tostring(ak)<tostring(bk)
    end)
    return result
end
local function maneuverLabel(s,key)
    local entry=maneuver and maneuver(s,key) or nil
    if entry then return maneuverDisplayName(key,entry.label) end
    for _,candidate in ipairs(dialFor(s)) do if candidate.key==key then return maneuverDisplayName(key,candidate.label) end end
    return key and maneuverDisplayName(key,key) or "No maneuver selected"
end
-- Object XML tooltips rotate with the dial. Display hover help in the flat HUD.
STA2E.DialHover={objects={},players={},colors={"White","Brown","Red","Orange","Yellow","Green","Teal","Blue","Purple","Pink","Grey","Black"}}
function STA2E.DialHover.clear(guid)
    for color,row in pairs(STA2E.DialHover.players) do
        if not guid or row.guid==guid then
            STA2E.DialHover.players[color]=nil
            UI.setAttribute("sta2e_hover_"..color,"active","false")
        end
    end
end
function STA2E.DialHover.decode(value)
    return tostring(value or ""):gsub(""",'"'):gsub("'","'"):gsub("<","<"):gsub(">",">"):gsub("&","&")
end
function STA2E.DialHover.allowed(restrictions,color)
    for _,targets in ipairs(restrictions) do
        local match=false
        for target in targets:gmatch("[^|]+") do if target==color then match=true end end
        if not match then return false end
    end
    return true
end
function STA2E.DialHover.find(guid,id,color)
    local registry=STA2E.DialHover.objects[guid]
    for _,button in ipairs(registry and registry.buttons[id] or {}) do
        if STA2E.DialHover.allowed(button.restrictions,color) then return button,registry end
    end
end
function STA2E.DialHover.panels()
    local parts={}
    for _,color in ipairs(STA2E.DialHover.colors) do
        local row=STA2E.DialHover.players[color]
        local shown=row and row.shown==true
        table.insert(parts,'<Panel id="sta2e_hover_'..color..'" visibility="'..color..'" active="'..tostring(shown==true)..'" rectAlignment="LowerCenter" offsetXY="0 110" width="560" height="72" color="#D9D9D9E8" raycastTarget="false">'..
            '<Panel width="558" height="70" color="#111111F5" raycastTarget="false">'..
            '<Text id="sta2e_hover_text_'..color..'" text="'..xml(shown and row.text or "")..'" width="532" height="58" fontSize="18" alignment="MiddleCenter" horizontalOverflow="Wrap" verticalOverflow="Truncate" color="#FFFFFF" raycastTarget="false"/>'..
            '</Panel></Panel>')
    end
    return table.concat(parts)
end
function STA2E_SetDialXml(dial,markup)
    local guid=dial.getGUID()
    STA2E.DialHover.clear(guid)
    local registry={buttons={}}
    STA2E.DialHover.objects[guid]=registry
    -- Track parent visibility so a hover never exposes another player's controls.
    local panels={}
    for closing,tag,attributes in markup:gmatch('<(/?)([%w]+)([^>]*)>') do
        if tag=="Panel" then
            if closing=="/" then table.remove(panels)
            elseif not attributes:match('/%s*$') then panels[#panels+1]=attributes:match('visibility="([^"]+)"') or "" end
        elseif tag=="Button" and closing=="" then
            local id=attributes:match('id="([^"]+)"')
            local help=attributes:match('tooltip="([^"]*)"')
            if id and help and help~="" then
                local restrictions={}
                for _,targets in ipairs(panels) do if targets~="" then restrictions[#restrictions+1]=targets end end
                local ownTargets=attributes:match('visibility="([^"]+)"')
                if ownTargets then restrictions[#restrictions+1]=ownTargets end
                registry.buttons[id]=registry.buttons[id] or {}
                table.insert(registry.buttons[id],{text=STA2E.DialHover.decode(help),restrictions=restrictions})
            end
        end
    end
    markup=markup:gsub('<Button%s+([^>]+)>',function(attributes)
        if not attributes:find('tooltip="',1,true) then return '<Button '..attributes..'>' end
        attributes=attributes:gsub('%s+tooltip="[^"]*"',"")
        return '<Button '..attributes..' onMouseEnter="STA2E_DialHoverEnter" onMouseExit="STA2E_DialHoverExit" onMouseDown="STA2E_DialHoverExit">'
    end)
    dial.UI.setXml(markup)
end
function STA2E_DialHover(params)
    local object=params and params.object
    local color=params and params.color
    if not object or not color then return end
    local guid=object.getGUID()
    if params.enter~=true then
        local row=STA2E.DialHover.players[color]
        if row and row.guid==guid and row.id==params.id then
            STA2E.DialHover.players[color]=nil;UI.setAttribute("sta2e_hover_"..color,"active","false")
        end
        return
    end
    local button,registry=STA2E.DialHover.find(guid,params.id,color)
    if not button then return end
    local row={guid=guid,id=params.id,text=button.text,registry=registry}
    STA2E.DialHover.players[color]=row
    UI.setAttribute("sta2e_hover_"..color,"active","false")
    hud()
    Wait.time(function()
        if STA2E.DialHover.players[color]~=row or not obj(guid) or STA2E.DialHover.objects[guid]~=registry then return end
        row.shown=true
        UI.setAttribute("sta2e_hover_text_"..color,"text",row.text)
        UI.setAttribute("sta2e_hover_"..color,"active","true")
    end,0.35)
end

local function refresh(s)
    if STA2E.loading and STA2E.startupRefreshQueue and not STA2E.startupFlushing then
        STA2E.startupRefreshQueue[s.instanceId]=s
        return
    end
    commit(s);render(s)
end
local function sync(s)
    local base, model = member(s,"base"),member(s,"model")
    if not base or not model then return end
    if base.getGUID()==model.getGUID() then return end
    local p, r = base.getPosition(),base.getRotation()
    local ship=SHIP_DEFINITIONS[s.definitionId]
    model.setPosition({p.x,p.y+(ship and ship.model.offsetY or -1.2),p.z}); model.setRotation({r.x,r.y,r.z})
end
function STA2E_Register(params)
    if not STA2E.ready and not (STA2E.startupRegistering and STA2E.startupThread and coroutine.running()==STA2E.startupThread) then return end
    local object = params.object
    local m = metadata(object)
    if not m or m.schemaVersion ~= 1 then return end
    if m.role == "card" then
        if not own(m.owner) or not CATALOG[m.definitionId] or CATALOG[m.definitionId].type~="ship" then return end
        local guid = object.getGUID()
        local existing = m.instanceId and STA2E.ships[m.instanceId]
        -- Keep the same runtime record while asynchronous deployment callbacks hold it.
        if existing and existing.cardGUID==guid then if not STA2E.reconciling then render(existing) end;return end
        -- Copied cards must never inherit another card's component references.
        if (m.cardGUID and m.cardGUID ~= guid) or not m.instanceId then
            m.instanceId = nextId(); m.refs = {}; m.upgrades = {}; m.fleetId = "copy-"..m.instanceId
            m.state = {status="planning"}; m.deployedOnce = false
        end
        m.cardGUID=guid; m.refs=m.refs or {}; m.upgrades=m.upgrades or {}; m.state=m.state or {status="planning"}
        m.capabilities=capabilities(m.definitionId)
        STA2E.ships[m.instanceId] = m
        if not STA2E.reconciling then refresh(m) end
    elseif not STA2E.reconciling and m.instanceId and STA2E.ships[m.instanceId] then
        render(STA2E.ships[m.instanceId])
    end
end
function STA2E_Reconcile()
    -- One snapshot and one metadata read per object, including missing references.
    local roots, components = {}, {}
    STA2E.reconciling=true
    for _,object in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        local m=metadata(object)
        if m and m.role=="pending" and m.transaction then object.destruct()
        elseif m then
            if m.role=="card" then table.insert(roots,object) end
            if m.instanceId and m.cardGUID then
                components[m.instanceId]=components[m.instanceId] or {}
                local byCard=components[m.instanceId]
                byCard[m.cardGUID]=byCard[m.cardGUID] or {}
                local byRole=byCard[m.cardGUID]
                local roles=m.role=="baseModel" and {"base","model"} or {m.role}
                for _,role in ipairs(roles) do
                    byRole[role]=byRole[role] or {}
                    table.insert(byRole[role],object)
                end
            end
        end
        STA2E_StartupYield("objects")
    end
    for _,object in ipairs(roots) do STA2E_Register({object=object});STA2E_StartupYield("registered") end
    for _,s in pairs(STA2E.ships) do
        s.conflicts={}
        local byCard=components[s.instanceId] or {}
        local byRole=byCard[s.cardGUID] or {}
        for _,role in ipairs({"base","model","dial","reference"}) do
            if not member(s,role) then
                local candidates=byRole[role] or {}
                if #candidates==1 then s.refs[role]=candidates[1].getGUID()
                else s.refs[role]=nil;if #candidates>1 then s.conflicts[role]=true end end
            end
        end
        sync(s);refresh(s);STA2E_StartupYield("linked")
    end
    STA2E.reconciling=false
end

local function playerSideTransform(owner,anchor,offset)

local function spawnActionToken(s,key)
    if key=="ECHO" then if STA2E_StartSensorEcho then STA2E_StartSensorEcho({color=s.owner,instanceId=s.instanceId,sourceType="ship"}) end;return end
    local bag=obj(ACTION_BAGS[key]);local base=member(s,"base");local card=obj(s.cardGUID)
    if not bag or (SHIP_ADJACENT_TOKENS[key] and not base) or (not SHIP_ADJACENT_TOKENS[key] and not card) then tell(s.owner,"Action recorded; its table token bag or destination is unavailable.");return end
    local target
    if SHIP_ADJACENT_TOKENS[key] then
        local p,r=base.getPosition(),base.getRotation();local side=math.rad(r.y+90)
        local count=(s.state.spawnedTokens or 0)+1;s.state.spawnedTokens=count
        local ahead=math.rad(r.y);local lane=(count-1)%5-2;local gap=1.8+math.floor((count-1)/5)*0.6
        target={p.x-math.sin(side)*gap-math.sin(ahead)*lane*0.42,p.y+1,p.z-math.cos(side)*gap-math.cos(ahead)*lane*0.42}
    else
        local p,r=card.getPosition(),card.getRotation()
        local count=(s.state.spawnedCardTokens or 0)+1;s.state.spawnedCardTokens=count
        local localX=-0.72+((count-1)%4)*0.48

        local angle=math.rad(r.y or 0)
        local dx=localX*math.cos(angle)+localZ*math.sin(angle)

        target={p.x+dx,p.y+0.55,p.z+dz}
    end

function STA2E_Command(params)
    local s=shipFor(params.object)
    if not s then return end
    local cmd=params.command or ""
    if cmd=="deploy" then tell(params.color,deploy(s));return end
    if cmd=="open_dial" then
        local dial=member(s,"dial")
        if not dial then tell(params.color,"Deploy / Repair the ship first.");return end
        s.state.dialOpen=not (s.state.dialOpen==true)

        refresh(s);return
    end
    if cmd=="sync" then sync(s);return end
    if not complete(s) then tell(params.color,"Deploy / Repair this ship first.");return end
    local phase=STA2E.game.phase
    if cmd:sub(1,7)=="select_" then
        local key=cmd:sub(8)
        if not maneuver(s,key) then tell(params.color,"That maneuver is not on this ship's dial.");return end
        if phase~="planning" then tell(params.color,"Open play: selecting a maneuver outside Planning.") end
        if s.state.status=="locked" then tell(params.color,"Choose Change Maneuver before selecting a different maneuver.");return end
        s.state.maneuver=key;s.state.status="planning"
    elseif cmd=="lock" then
        if phase~="planning" then tell(params.color,"Maneuvers may only be locked during Planning.");return end
        if not s.state.maneuver then tell(params.color,"Choose a maneuver before locking it.");return end
        s.state.status="locked"
        broadcastToAll(s.name.." has locked in its maneuver.",{0.82,0.90,1})
    elseif cmd=="change" then
        if phase~="planning" or s.state.status~="locked" then tell(params.color,"That maneuver can no longer be changed.");return end
        s.state.status="planning"
    elseif cmd=="reveal" then
        if not s.state.maneuver then tell(params.color,"Choose a maneuver before revealing it.");return end
        if phase~="activation" or s.state.status~="locked" then tell(params.color,"Open play: revealing outside the normal Activation sequence.") end
        s.state.status="revealed"
        broadcastToAll(s.name.." has revealed a maneuver of "..maneuverLabel(s,s.state.maneuver)..".",{0.82,0.90,1})
    elseif cmd=="move" then
        local move=MOVE_DEFS[s.state.maneuver]
        if not move or not maneuver(s,s.state.maneuver) then tell(params.color,"No supported movement for this selection.");return end
        if phase~="activation" or s.state.status~="revealed" then tell(params.color,"Open play: executing outside the normal revealed Activation step.") end
        local base=member(s,"base");local p,r=base.getPosition(),base.getRotation()
        s.undo={position={p.x,p.y,p.z},rotation={r.x,r.y,r.z},state=copy(s.state),round=STA2E.game.round}
        local angle=math.rad(r.y);local side=math.rad(r.y+90)
        base.setPosition({p.x-math.sin(angle)*(move.forward or 0)+math.sin(side)*(move.side or 0),p.y,p.z-math.cos(angle)*(move.forward or 0)+math.cos(side)*(move.side or 0)})
        base.setRotation({r.x,r.y+(move.rotate or 0),r.z})
        s.state.status="action";sync(s)
        broadcastToAll(s.name.." has executed a maneuver of "..maneuverLabel(s,s.state.maneuver)..".",{0.82,0.90,1})
    elseif cmd=="undo" then
        if not s.undo or s.undo.round~=STA2E.game.round then tell(params.color,"No movement undo is available this round.");return end
        local base=member(s,"base");base.setPosition(s.undo.position);base.setRotation(s.undo.rotation)
        s.state=s.undo.state;s.undo=nil;sync(s)
    elseif cmd:sub(1,7)=="action_" then
        local key=cmd:sub(8)
        local allowed=false;for _,action in ipairs((s.capabilities and s.capabilities.actions) or {}) do if action==key then allowed=true end end
        if not allowed then tell(params.color,"Open play: recording a card-granted action.") end
        if phase~="activation" or s.state.status~="action" then tell(params.color,"Open play: recording an action outside the normal action step.") end
        if key=="ECHO" then
            if STA2E_StartSensorEcho then STA2E_StartSensorEcho({color=params.color,instanceId=s.instanceId,source=params.object,sourceType="ship"}) end
            return
        end
        s.state.action=key;spawnActionToken(s,key)
        if s.state.status=="action" then s.state.status="complete" end
    elseif cmd=="finish" then
        if phase~="activation" or s.state.status~="action" then tell(params.color,"Open play: marking this ship complete outside the normal action step.") end
        s.state.status="complete"
    else tell(params.color,"Unknown ship command.");return end
    refresh(s)
    hud()
end

        if g.phase=="activation" then g.phase="planning"
        elseif g.phase=="combat" then g.phase="activation"
        elseif g.phase=="end" then g.phase="combat"
        elseif g.phase=="planning" then
            if (tonumber(g.round) or 0)>1 then g.round=g.round-1;g.phase="end"
            else g.round=0;g.phase="setup" end
        else tell(player.color,"Setup is the first phase; there is no previous phase.");return end
        for _,s in pairs(STA2E.ships) do refresh(s) end
        hud();return
    end
    if g.phase=="planning" then
        local locked,total=lockedCount()
        if locked<total then
            tell(player.color,tostring(total-locked).." eligible ship(s) do not have locked maneuvers. Activation cannot begin until every maneuver is selected and locked.")
            return
        end
    end
    if next(STA2E.pending) or next(STA2E.imports) then tell(player.color,"Wait for spawning to finish.");return end
    if g.phase=="setup" then
        g.phase="planning";g.round=1
    elseif g.phase=="planning" then
        g.phase="activation"
    elseif g.phase=="activation" then
        g.phase="combat"
    elseif g.phase=="combat" then g.phase="end"
    else
        g.phase="planning";g.round=g.round+1
        for _,s in pairs(STA2E.ships) do
            local dialOpen=s.state and s.state.dialOpen==true
            local toolsPage=s.state and s.state.toolsPage
            local cardMenuOpen=s.state and s.state.cardMenuOpen==true
            s.state={status="planning",dialOpen=dialOpen,toolsPage=toolsPage,cardMenuOpen=cardMenuOpen};s.undo=nil;refresh(s)
        end
    end
    for _,s in pairs(STA2E.ships) do refresh(s) end
    hud()
end

local function array(value)
    if type(value)~="table" then return false end
    local n=0
    for k in pairs(value) do
        if type(k)~="number" or k<1 or k%1~=0 then return false end
        n=n+1
    end
    return n==#value
end

local function join(values)
    local result={}
    for _,value in ipairs(values or {}) do table.insert(result,tostring(value)) end
    return table.concat(result,", ")
end

        SidewaysCard=false,CustomDeck=customDeck,LuaScript="",LuaScriptState="",XmlUI=""
    }

local function canonicalFromDevelopment(value)
    if type(value)~="table" or value.schemaVersion~=1 or not array(value.ships) then return nil,"Unsupported JSON fleet format." end
    local fleet={schemaVersion=2,fleetId=value.fleetId,source={kind="development-json"},ships={},resources={},warnings={}}
    for _,sourceShip in ipairs(value.ships) do
        if type(sourceShip)~="table" or type(sourceShip.shipCardId)~="string" then return nil,"Invalid development ship entry." end
        if sourceShip.captainId~=nil and type(sourceShip.captainId)~="string" then return nil,"Invalid development captain ID." end
        if sourceShip.upgradeIds~=nil and not array(sourceShip.upgradeIds) then return nil,"Invalid development upgrade list." end
        local ship={shipCardId=sourceShip.shipCardId,cards={}}
        if sourceShip.captainId then table.insert(ship.cards,{cardId=sourceShip.captainId,role="captain"}) end
        for _,id in ipairs(sourceShip.upgradeIds or {}) do
            if type(id)~="string" then return nil,"Invalid development upgrade ID." end
            table.insert(ship.cards,{cardId=id,role=(CATALOG[id] and CATALOG[id].type) or "upgrade"})
        end
        table.insert(fleet.ships,ship)
    end
    return fleet
end

local function parseFleet(text)
    text=tostring(text or ""):gsub("^\239\187\191","")
    if text:match("^%s*{") then
        local value=decode(text)
        if type(value)=="table" and value.schemaVersion==2 and array(value.ships) then return value end
        return canonicalFromDevelopment(value)
    end
    local fleet={schemaVersion=2,source={kind="utopia-tts"},ships={},resources={},warnings={}}
    local unknown,missing,ungrouped={},{},{}
    local current=nil
    for raw in (text.."\n"):gmatch("([^\r\n]*)[\r\n]") do
        local id=raw:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        if id:match("^%-%-%-+%s*$") or id:lower():match("^generated by utopia") then break end
        if id~="" then
            local hidden=id:sub(1,1)=="#"
            if hidden then id=id:sub(2):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") end
            local card=CATALOG[id]
            if not card then
                table.insert(unknown,id)
            elseif not card.cardImage or not card.cardBack then
                table.insert(missing,id)
            elseif card.type=="ship" then
                current={shipCardId=id,cards={}}
                table.insert(fleet.ships,current)
            elseif card.type=="resource" then
                table.insert(fleet.resources,{cardId=id,role="resource",hidden=hidden or nil})
            elseif current then
                table.insert(current.cards,{cardId=id,role=card.type or "upgrade",hidden=hidden or nil})
            else
                table.insert(ungrouped,id)
            end
        end
    end
    if #unknown>0 then return nil,"Unknown ID(s): "..join(unknown) end
    if #missing>0 then return nil,"No full-card asset for: "..join(missing) end
    if #ungrouped>0 then return nil,"Card(s) before the first ship: "..join(ungrouped) end
    if #fleet.ships==0 then return nil,"Paste a list containing at least one ship ID." end
    return fleet
end

local function fleetLayout(fleet)
    local maxSlots,maxRows=14,3
    local rows={}
    local function place(entries,shipIndex,standalone)
        local length=#entries
        if length>maxSlots then
            local label=standalone and "The resource group" or ("Ship "..tostring(shipIndex))
            return false,label.." has "..length.." cards; the play mat allows 14 per row."
        end
        local row=rows[#rows]
        local needed=length
        if row and row.used>0 then needed=needed+2 end
        if not row or row.used+needed>maxSlots then
            if #rows>=maxRows then return false,"Fleet needs more than 3 rows of 14 card spaces." end
            row={used=0,groups={}}
            table.insert(rows,row)
        end
        local start=row.used==0 and 1 or row.used+3
        table.insert(row.groups,{entries=entries,shipIndex=shipIndex,standalone=standalone,start=start})
        row.used=start+length-1
        return true
    end
    for i,ship in ipairs(fleet.ships or {}) do
        local entries={{cardId=ship.shipCardId,role="ship"}}
        for _,entry in ipairs(ship.cards or {}) do table.insert(entries,entry) end
        local ok,err=place(entries,i,false)
        if not ok then return nil,err end
    end
    if #(fleet.resources or {})>0 then
        local ok,err=place(fleet.resources,nil,true)
        if not ok then return nil,err end
    end
    return rows
end

local function reviewFleet(fleet)
    if type(fleet)~="table" or fleet.schemaVersion~=2 or not array(fleet.ships) or #fleet.ships==0 then return nil,"No valid ships were found." end
    if fleet.source~=nil and type(fleet.source)~="table" then return nil,"Invalid fleet source." end
    if fleet.fleetId~=nil and type(fleet.fleetId)~="string" then return nil,"Invalid fleet identity." end
    if fleet.resources~=nil and not array(fleet.resources) then return nil,"Invalid resource list." end
    local total,cost,ready=0,0,0
    local names={}
    for _,ship in ipairs(fleet.ships) do
        if type(ship)~="table" or type(ship.shipCardId)~="string" then return nil,"Invalid ship entry." end
        local root=CATALOG[ship.shipCardId]
        if not root or root.type~="ship" then return nil,"Unknown ship ID: "..tostring(ship.shipCardId) end
        if not root.cardImage or not root.cardBack then return nil,"No full-card asset for: "..ship.shipCardId end
        total=total+1
        cost=cost+(tonumber(root.cost) or 0)
        if SHIP_DEFINITIONS[ship.shipCardId] then ready=ready+1 end
        table.insert(names,(root.name or root.id).." ["..tostring(root.cost or "?").."]")
        if ship.cards~=nil and not array(ship.cards) then return nil,"Invalid card list for "..root.id end
        for _,entry in ipairs(ship.cards or {}) do
            if type(entry)~="table" or type(entry.cardId)~="string" then return nil,"Invalid card entry for "..root.id end
            local card=CATALOG[entry.cardId]
            if not card then return nil,"Unknown ID: "..tostring(entry.cardId) end
            if not card.cardImage or not card.cardBack then return nil,"No full-card asset for: "..entry.cardId end
            total=total+1
            cost=cost+(tonumber(card.cost) or 0)
        end
    end
    for _,entry in ipairs(fleet.resources or {}) do
        if type(entry)~="table" or type(entry.cardId)~="string" then return nil,"Invalid resource entry." end
        local card=CATALOG[entry.cardId]
        if not card or not card.cardImage or not card.cardBack then return nil,"Resource cannot be spawned: "..tostring(entry.cardId) end
        total=total+1;cost=cost+(tonumber(card.cost) or 0)
    end
    local layout,layoutError=fleetLayout(fleet)
    if not layout then return nil,layoutError end
    return {ships=#fleet.ships,cards=total,cost=cost,ready=ready,names=names,rows=#layout}
end

local function spawnFleetShields(s)

            if token then token.setGMNotes("STA2E_SHIP_TOKEN|"..s.instanceId.."|SHIELD") end
        end})
    end

function STA2E_ImportFleet(params)
    local color=params.color
    if not own(color) then return {ok=false,error="Sit in a fleet color to import."} end
    if next(STA2E.imports) then return {ok=false,error="Wait for the current fleet import to finish."} end
    local fleet=params.fleet or decode(params.json)
    local err=validate(fleet)
    if err then return {ok=false,error=err} end
    fleet.fleetId=fleet.fleetId or ("paste-"..tostring(STA2E.game.nextId+1))
    local key=color..":"..fleet.fleetId
    if STA2E.game.fleets[key] or STA2E.imports[key] then return {ok=false,error="This fleet is already imported. Change its fleetId to import another copy."} end
    local jobs,ids={},{}
    local layout,layoutError=fleetLayout(fleet)
    if not layout then return {ok=false,error=layoutError} end
    local boardPosition,cardRotation=fleetStagingLane(color)
    if not boardPosition then return {ok=false,error="The fleet staging board or this color's hand zone is missing."} end
    local shipInstances={}
    for i,ship in ipairs(fleet.ships) do
        local instanceId=nextId()
        table.insert(ids,instanceId)
        local root=CATALOG[ship.shipCardId]
        shipInstances[i]={schemaVersion=1,role="card",instanceId=instanceId,definitionId=root.id,name=importedShipName(root),owner=color,fleetId=key,refs={},upgrades={},capabilities=capabilities(root.id),state={status="planning",dialOpen=false},shieldCount=tonumber(root.shields) or 0,physicalReady=SHIP_DEFINITIONS[root.id]~=nil}
        STA2E_M5Attach(shipInstances[i],ship)
    end
    -- Each card row also owns the component lane 4.8 units in front of it.
    -- Keep enough pitch for the deployed base, dial, and reference to sit clear
    -- of the neighboring row, matching the fleet groups laid out on the mat.
    local spacing,rowSpacing=2.45,8.5
    for rowIndex,row in ipairs(layout) do
        local left=-((row.used-1)*spacing)/2
        local rowForward=(rowIndex-(#layout+1)/2)*rowSpacing
        for _,group in ipairs(row.groups) do
            local s=group.shipIndex and shipInstances[group.shipIndex] or nil
            -- Ship groups are laid out from the root card toward its right:
            -- root, upgrades, then any face-down cards fanned with their host.
            -- Standalone resource groups retain their listed order.
            local reverseGroup=not group.standalone
            local finalSlot=group.start+#group.entries-1
            local anchorSlot=reverseGroup and finalSlot or group.start
            local hiddenOffset=0
            for j,entry in ipairs(group.entries) do
                local slot=reverseGroup and (finalSlot-j+1) or (group.start+j-1)
                if entry.hidden then hiddenOffset=hiddenOffset+1 else anchorSlot=slot;hiddenOffset=0 end
                local fanDirection=reverseGroup and -1 or 1
                local cardSide=left+((entry.hidden and anchorSlot or slot)-1)*spacing+(entry.hidden and fanDirection*hiddenOffset*0.38 or 0)
                local cardForward=rowForward+(entry.hidden and hiddenOffset*0.12 or 0)
                local target=playerSideTransform(color,boardPosition,{side=cardSide,forward=cardForward,up=entry.hidden and 0.39 or 0.35})
                table.insert(jobs,{ship=s,cardId=entry.cardId,root=not group.standalone and j==1,hidden=entry.hidden==true,position=target.position,index=j-1,standalone=group.standalone})
            end
        end
    end
    local tx={objects={},roots={},left=#jobs,ids=ids};STA2E.imports[key]=tx
    local function rollback(reason)
        if STA2E.imports[key]~=tx then return end
        STA2E.imports[key]=nil
        for _,id in ipairs(ids) do STA2E.ships[id]=nil end
        for _,object in ipairs(tx.objects) do if obj(object.getGUID()) then object.destruct() end end
        tell(color,"Import rolled back: "..reason)
    end
    local function finish()
        if tx.left~=0 then return end
        for _,s in pairs(tx.roots) do
            for _,u in ipairs(s.upgrades) do
                local object=obj(u.guid)
                if object then object.call("STA2E_SetMemory",{schemaVersion=1,role="upgrade",instanceId=s.instanceId,cardGUID=s.cardGUID,cardId=u.cardId,fleetId=key}) end
            end
            table.sort(s.upgrades,function(a,b)return a.index<b.index end)
            STA2E.ships[s.instanceId]=s;STA2E.AllianceCaptain.syncShipName(s);STA2E.AllianceCaptain.syncCaptain(s);commit(s);spawnFleetShields(s);deploy(s);refresh(s)
        end
        STA2E.game.fleets[key]=ids
        STA2E.imports[key]=nil
        tell(color,"Fleet cards spawned; ships, dials, and maneuver references are deploying.")
    end
    for _,jobValue in ipairs(jobs) do
        local job=jobValue
        local card=CATALOG[job.cardId]
        local data=cardData(card)
        if not data then rollback("No complete card asset for "..job.cardId);break end
        data.GUID=nil;data.States=nil
        if not card.interactiveCaptain then data.LuaScript=MEMBER_SCRIPT;data.XmlUI="" end
        if job.root then data.Transform.scaleX=1.2;data.Transform.scaleZ=1.2 end
        data.LuaScriptState=card.interactiveCaptain and STA2E.AllianceCaptain.pendingState(data,color,key) or JSON.encode({schemaVersion=1,role="pending",transaction=key})
        local ok,spawnError=pcall(function()
            spawnObjectData({data=data,position=job.position,rotation={0,cardRotation,0},callback_function=function(object)
                if STA2E.imports[key]~=tx then object.destruct();return end
                if job.hidden then object.flip() end
                table.insert(tx.objects,object)
                if job.standalone then
                    object.call("STA2E_SetMemory",{schemaVersion=1,role="fleetCard",fleetId=key,cardId=job.cardId})
                else
                    local s=job.ship
                    if job.root then
                        s.cardGUID=object.getGUID()
                        local target=playerSideTransform(s.owner,object.getPosition(),{forward=4.8,up=0.25})
                        s.spawnPosition={x=target.position.x,y=1.3,z=target.position.z}
                        s.spawnRotation=target.facing or target.rotation[2]
                        tx.roots[s.instanceId]=s
                    else table.insert(s.upgrades,{cardId=job.cardId,guid=object.getGUID(),index=job.index}) end
                end
                tx.left=tx.left-1;finish()
            end})
        end)
        if not ok then rollback(tostring(spawnError));break end
    end
    Wait.time(function() rollback("some cards did not finish spawning") end,15)
    return {ok=true,pending=true}
end

function STA2E_FleetSpawn(player)
    if not player or not own(player.color) then return end
    local fleet,err=parseFleet(STA2E.fleetText[player.color])

    if not fleet or err then STA2E.fleetStatus[player.color]="Cannot spawn: "..tostring(err);hud();return end

end

-- Provisional bank 3/4 calibration. Preserve the confirmed bank 1 and the
-- bank 2 offsets while testing a longer, slightly more lateral endpoint.
-- Both hands use the same values, mirrored by the sign of side/rotation.
local BANK_CALIBRATION={
    [3]={forward=6.40,side=2.62},
    [4]={forward=7.65,side=3.13},
}
for speed,calibration in pairs(BANK_CALIBRATION) do
    for _,hand in ipairs({{key="BL",sign=1},{key="BR",sign=-1}}) do
        local move=MOVE_DEFS[hand.key..speed]
        if move then move.forward=calibration.forward;move.side=hand.sign*calibration.side end
    end
end
-- The physical base artwork's left/right orientation is opposite the
-- movement table's local side convention. Mirror bank and turn paths together
-- so their lateral travel and final facing match the printed L/R labels.
for _,prefix in ipairs({"BL","BR","TL","TR"}) do
    for speed=1,4 do
        local move=MOVE_DEFS[prefix..speed]
        if move then move.side=-(move.side or 0);move.rotate=-(move.rotate or 0) end
    end
end
for speed=1,4 do
    local comeAbout=MOVE_DEFS["CA"..speed]
    if comeAbout then comeAbout.finishRotateOnly=true end
end

-- Connected speed-1 turns: Full About uses the same hand twice;
-- Impulse Roll changes hand for the second turn. Both traverse the full path.
-- Build after the existing L/R calibration so these match the normal turns.
do
    for _,entry in ipairs({{"FAL1","TL1","TL1"},{"FAR1","TR1","TR1"},{"IRL1","TL1","TR1"},{"IRR1","TR1","TL1"}}) do
        local first,second=copy(MOVE_DEFS[entry[2]]),copy(MOVE_DEFS[entry[3]])
        local angle=math.rad(first.rotate or 0)
        MOVE_DEFS[entry[1]]={
            forward=first.forward+math.cos(angle)*second.forward+math.sin(angle)*second.side,
            side=first.side-math.sin(angle)*second.forward+math.cos(angle)*second.side,
            rotate=(first.rotate or 0)+(second.rotate or 0),
            segments={first,second},connectedTemplates=true,
        }
    end
end

local function captainFor(s)
    for _,entry in ipairs(s.upgrades or {}) do
        local card=CATALOG[entry.cardId]
        if card and card.type=="captain" then
            local live=card.interactiveCaptain and s.allianceCaptain
            if live and live.guid==entry.guid then
                return {id=card.id,type="captain",name=live.name~="" and live.name or card.name,skill=live.skill}
            end
            return card
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function skillFor(s)
    local captain=captainFor(s)
    return tonumber(s.skillOverride) or (captain and tonumber(captain.skill)) or 0
end

local TRACKER_PLAYER_COLORS={Blue="#285779",Red="#713839",Green="#2F6A45",Purple="#62427A",Orange="#A45D24",Yellow="#8A741F"}
local TRACKER_OWNER_ORDER={Blue=1,Red=2,Green=3,Purple=4,Orange=5,Yellow=6}
local function sidebar()
    local ships={}
    for _,s in pairs(STA2E.ships) do
        if obj(s.cardGUID) then table.insert(ships,s) end
    end
    local phase=STA2E.game.phase
    local initiative=STA2E.game.initiative or "Blue"
    local ordered={}
    for ordinal,s in ipairs(ships) do
        local skill=tonumber(skillFor(s)) or 0;if skill~=skill then skill=0 end
        local initiativeOrder
        if phase=="activation" then initiativeOrder=s.owner==initiative and 1 or 0
        else initiativeOrder=s.owner==initiative and 0 or 1 end
        table.insert(ordered,{ship=s,skillOrder=phase=="combat" and -skill or skill,
            initiativeOrder=initiativeOrder,ownerOrder=TRACKER_OWNER_ORDER[s.owner] or 99,
            instanceId=tostring(s.instanceId or ""),ordinal=ordinal})
    end
    local function trackerBefore(a,b)
        if a.skillOrder~=b.skillOrder then return a.skillOrder<b.skillOrder end
        if a.initiativeOrder~=b.initiativeOrder then return a.initiativeOrder<b.initiativeOrder end
        if a.ownerOrder~=b.ownerOrder then return a.ownerOrder<b.ownerOrder end
        if a.instanceId~=b.instanceId then return a.instanceId<b.instanceId end
        return a.ordinal<b.ordinal
    end
    for i=2,#ordered do
        local entry=ordered[i];local j=i-1
        while j>=1 and trackerBefore(entry,ordered[j]) do ordered[j+1]=ordered[j];j=j-1 end
        ordered[j+1]=entry
    end
    ships={};for _,entry in ipairs(ordered) do table.insert(ships,entry.ship) end
    local initiative=STA2E.game.initiative or "Blue"
    local initiativeLabel="INIT "..initiative
    if phase=="setup" then initiativeLabel=initiative.." PLACES FIRST"
    elseif phase=="activation" then initiativeLabel=initiative.." ACTIVATES SECOND"
    elseif phase=="combat" then initiativeLabel=initiative.." ATTACKS FIRST" end
    local parts={'<Panel id="shipSidebar" rectAlignment="UpperLeft" offsetXY="58 -150" width="500" height="'..(130+math.max(#ships,1)*46)..'" color="#102432ED">',
        '<Text text="'..xml(phaseLabel(phase))..' · SHIPS" position="0 '..(33+math.max(#ships,1)*23)..' 0" width="350" height="33" fontSize="20" color="#FFFFFF"/>',
        '<Button id="initiative_toggle" onClick="STA2E_SidebarClick" position="0 '..(1+math.max(#ships,1)*23)..' 0" width="205" height="28" fontSize="12">'..xml(initiativeLabel)..'</Button>',
        '<Text text="Skill | Captain | Ship · Color" position="0 '..(-29+math.max(#ships,1)*23)..' 0" width="355" height="24" fontSize="14" color="#C8D9E8"/>'}
    for i,s in ipairs(ships) do
        local captain=captainFor(s)
        local name=captain and captain.name or "No captain"
        local status=s.state or {}
        local marker=(status.maneuver and "M" or "-").."/"..((status.status=="complete" or status.status=="action") and "A" or "-").."/"..(status.fired and "F" or "-")
        local aiRow=(s.ai and true) or (s.m5 and s.m5.controlled==true)
        local shade=aiRow and "#FFFFFF" or (TRACKER_PLAYER_COLORS[s.owner] or "#48515D")
        local rowText=aiRow and "#18202B" or "#FFFFFF"
        if not aiRow and phase=="combat" and status.fired then shade="#48515D" end
        local y=math.max(#ships,1)*23-58-(i-1)*46
        local rowName=s.ai and ("AI · "..s.name) or (name.." | "..s.name)
        table.insert(parts,'<Button id="focus_'..xml(s.instanceId)..'" onClick="STA2E_SidebarClick" position="-40 '..y..' 0" width="265" height="38" fontSize="14" color="'..shade..'" textColor="'..rowText..'">'..xml(tostring(skillFor(s))..' | '..rowName..' ['..marker..']')..'</Button>')
        table.insert(parts,'<Button id="skill_down_'..xml(s.instanceId)..'" onClick="STA2E_SidebarClick" position="106 '..y..' 0" width="27" height="38" fontSize="17">-</Button>')
        table.insert(parts,'<Button id="skill_up_'..xml(s.instanceId)..'" onClick="STA2E_SidebarClick" position="136 '..y..' 0" width="27" height="38" fontSize="17">+</Button>')
        table.insert(parts,'<Button id="fire_'..xml(s.instanceId)..'" onClick="STA2E_SidebarClick" position="166 '..y..' 0" width="27" height="38" fontSize="14">F</Button>')
        if s.m5 and s.m5.controlled then table.insert(parts,STA2E_M5TrackerButton(s,y))
        else
        if s.ai then table.insert(parts,'<Button id="activate_ai_'..xml(s.instanceId)..'" onClick="STA2E_SidebarClick" position="222 '..y..' 0" width="78" height="38" fontSize="12" color="#2B7651" textColor="#FFFFFF">ACT AI</Button>') end
        end
    end
    if #ships==0 then table.insert(parts,'<Text text="Deploy a ship to list it here" position="0 -48 0" width="350" height="26" fontSize="15" color="#FFFFFF"/>') end

local SECOND_PLAYER_TOKEN_GUID="9a8bc6"

local function swapInitiativeTokens()
    local initiativeToken=obj(INITIATIVE_TOKEN_GUID)
    local secondPlayerToken=obj(SECOND_PLAYER_TOKEN_GUID)
    if not initiativeToken or not secondPlayerToken then return false end
    local initiativePosition=initiativeToken.getPosition()
    local secondPlayerPosition=secondPlayerToken.getPosition()
    initiativeToken.setPositionSmooth(secondPlayerPosition,false,true)
    secondPlayerToken.setPositionSmooth(initiativePosition,false,true)
    return true
end

function STA2E_SidebarClick(player,value,id)
    if id=="initiative_toggle" and player and (own(player.color) or player.color=="Black") then
        STA2E.game.initiative=(STA2E.game.initiative or "Blue")=="Blue" and "Red" or "Blue"
        if not swapInitiativeTokens() then tell(player.color,"Initiative changed, but one or both table initiative tokens could not be found.") end
        hud();return
    end
    local aiId=id and id:match('^activate_ai_(.+)$')
    if aiId then STA2E_AllianceActivateAI({instanceId=aiId,color=player and player.color});return end
    if not id then return end
    local action,actionId=id:match('^(skill_down)_(.+)$')
    if not action then action,actionId=id:match('^(skill_up)_(.+)$') end
    if not action then action,actionId=id:match('^(fire)_(.+)$') end
    if action then
        local controlled=STA2E.ships[actionId]
        if not controlled or not player then return end
        if action=="fire" then controlled.state.fired=not controlled.state.fired
        else controlled.skillOverride=math.max(0,skillFor(controlled)+(action=="skill_up" and 1 or -1)) end
        refresh(controlled);return
    end
    local instance=id and id:match('^focus_(.+)$')
    local s=instance and STA2E.ships[instance]
    if not s then return end
    local target=member(s,"base") or obj(s.cardGUID)
    if not target then return end
    local p=target.getPosition()
    player.lookAt({position=p,pitch=55,distance=16})
    target.highlightOn(s.owner,2)
    local card=obj(s.cardGUID)
    if card and card~=target then card.highlightOn(s.owner,2) end
end

local TOKEN_BAGS={time="410976",disable="64e3ba"}
local function taggedTokens(card,kind)
    local prefix="STA2E_TOKEN|"..card.getGUID().."|"..kind
    local found={}
    for _,object in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if object.getGMNotes() == prefix then table.insert(found,object) end
    end
    return found
end

local function clearCardTokens(card)
    local p=card.getPosition()
    local bounds=card.getBounds()
    local halfX=math.max(0.6,(bounds.size.x or 2)/2)
    local halfZ=math.max(0.6,(bounds.size.z or 3)/2)
    local removed={}
    for _,kind in ipairs({"time","disable"}) do
        for _,token in ipairs(taggedTokens(card,kind)) do removed[token.getGUID()]=token end
    end
    -- Also clear player-placed physical tokens sitting on the card.
    -- Cards are laid at 0 or 180 degrees in the fleet rows, so their AABB is usable here.
    for _,object in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        local kind=object.type
        if object~=card and (kind=="Custom_Token" or kind=="Chip" or kind=="Custom_Model") then
            local q=object.getPosition()
            if q.y>=p.y-0.1 and q.y<=p.y+2 and math.abs(q.x-p.x)<=halfX and math.abs(q.z-p.z)<=halfZ then
                removed[object.getGUID()]=object
            end
        end
    end
    for _,token in pairs(removed) do token.destruct() end
end

function STA2E_ManageAction(player,value,id)
    if not player or not own(player.color) then return end
    local card,m=managedObject(player.color)
    if not card then hud();return end
    STA2E.managePage=STA2E.managePage or {}
    local s=m.instanceId and STA2E.ships[m.instanceId]
    if id=="close" then STA2E.manageCard[player.color]=nil;STA2E.managePage[player.color]=nil;hud();return end
    if id=="reminder" then STA2E_SpawnReminder({object=card,color=player.color});return end
    if id=="actions" then
        if not s then tell(player.color,"This card is not associated with a ship.");return end
        STA2E.managePage[player.color]="actions";hud();return
    end
    if id=="action_back" then STA2E.managePage[player.color]="main";hud();return end
    local action=id:match("^manage_action_(.+)$")
    if action then
        if not s then tell(player.color,"This card is not associated with a ship.");return end
        local root=obj(s.cardGUID)
        if not root then tell(player.color,"The associated ship card is missing.");return end
        STA2E_Command({object=root,color=player.color,command="action_"..action})
        STA2E.managePage[player.color]="main";hud();return
    end
    if id=="arcs" or id=="clear" or id:match("^range_[123]$") then
        if not s then tell(player.color,"This card is not associated with a ship.");return end
        if id=="arcs" then s.state.guideArc=not s.state.guideArc
        elseif id=="clear" then s.state.guideArc=false;s.state.guideRange=0
        else s.state.guideRange=tonumber(id:sub(-1)) end
        drawShipGuides(s);refresh(s);return
    end
    if id=="discard" then
        clearCardTokens(card)
        STA2E.manageCard[player.color]=nil;STA2E.managePage[player.color]=nil
        card.flip();hud();return
    end
    local kind,operation=id:match("^(time)_(%a+)$")
    if not kind then kind,operation=id:match("^(disable)_(%a+)$") end
    if operation~="add" and operation~="remove" then return end
    if not kind then return end
    local tokens=taggedTokens(card,kind)
    if operation=="remove" then
        if #tokens>0 then tokens[#tokens].destruct() else tell(player.color,"No managed "..kind.." token on this card.") end
        return
    end
    local bag=obj(TOKEN_BAGS[kind])
    if not bag then tell(player.color,"The "..kind.." token bag is missing.");return end
    local p=card.getPosition()
    local index=#tokens
    bag.takeObject({position={p.x-0.6+(index%4)*0.38,p.y+0.5,p.z+0.8+math.floor(index/4)*0.38},callback_function=function(token)
        if token then token.setGMNotes("STA2E_TOKEN|"..card.getGUID().."|"..kind) end
    end})
end
