-- Movement templates are independent of a ship's printed dial.
local function pose(start,move,t,baseHalfLength)
    if move.connectedTemplates then
        assert(baseHalfLength~=nil,"Connected templates require the ship base half-length")
        local progress=math.max(0,math.min(1,t))
        local heading=math.rad(start.yaw)
        -- Start at the front edge. Each template connects directly to the next;
        -- remove the virtual ship half-base at BOTH ends of each ordinary turn.
        local current={x=start.x-math.sin(heading)*baseHalfLength,
            z=start.z-math.cos(heading)*baseHalfLength,yaw=start.yaw}
        local segmentProgress=progress*#move.segments
        for index,segment in ipairs(move.segments) do
            local angle=math.rad(segment.rotate or 0)
            local template={
                forward=(segment.forward or 0)-baseHalfLength*(1+math.cos(angle)),
                side=(segment.side or 0)+baseHalfLength*math.sin(angle),
                rotate=segment.rotate or 0,
            }
            local portion=math.max(0,math.min(1,segmentProgress-(index-1)))
            current=pose(current,template,portion)
            if portion<1 then break end
        end
        -- The ship straddles the connection at halfway. Its rear edge sits at
        -- the template exit when finished, without a base-sized gap at the join.
        local attachment=baseHalfLength*(2*progress-1)
        local facing=math.rad(current.yaw)
        return {x=current.x-math.sin(facing)*attachment,
            z=current.z-math.cos(facing)*attachment,yaw=current.yaw}
    end
    if move.segments then
        local progress=math.max(0,math.min(1,t))*#move.segments
        local current={x=start.x,z=start.z,yaw=start.yaw}
        for index,segment in ipairs(move.segments) do
            local portion=math.max(0,math.min(1,progress-(index-1)))
            current=pose(current,segment,portion)
            if portion<1 then break end
        end
        return current
    end
    local heading=math.rad(start.yaw)
    local forward,side=move.forward or 0,move.side or 0
    local rotation=move.rotate or 0
    local travelRotation=move.pathRotate or (move.finishRotateOnly and 0 or rotation)
    local progressForward,progressSide=forward*t,side*t
    if math.abs(travelRotation)>0 and forward>0 and side~=0 then
        -- Bank/turn templates follow a curved path while retaining the measured
        -- endpoint offsets from the original mod. Positive side is ship-left.
        local angle=math.rad(math.abs(travelRotation))
        progressForward=forward*math.sin(angle*t)/math.sin(angle)
        progressSide=side*(1-math.cos(angle*t))/(1-math.cos(angle))
    end
    local sideHeading=heading+math.pi/2
    local x=start.x-math.sin(heading)*progressForward-math.sin(sideHeading)*progressSide
    local z=start.z-math.cos(heading)*progressForward-math.cos(sideHeading)*progressSide
    local yaw=start.yaw-travelRotation*t
    if (move.finishRotateOnly or move.pathRotate) and t>=1 then yaw=start.yaw-rotation end
    return {x=x,z=z,yaw=yaw}
end

local function baseShape(object)
    local bounds=object.getBoundsNormalized()
    local size=bounds and bounds.size or {x=2.8,z=2.8}
    local offset=bounds and bounds.offset or {}
    -- Normalized collider bounds may be off-center. Keep that offset with the
    -- footprint, so rotating/moving it does not create an artificial bump gap.
    -- A small object keeps its real size instead of acquiring a 1-unit box.
    -- Missing or not-yet-loaded colliders retain the usual safe fallback.
    local function half(value) value=tonumber(value);return value and value>0 and value/2 or 1.4 end
    local shape={x=half(size.x),z=half(size.z),offsetX=tonumber(offset.x) or 0,offsetZ=tonumber(offset.z) or 0}
    local custom=object.getCustomObject and object.getCustomObject() or nil
    local objectType=string.lower(object.type or "")
    if custom and (objectType=="custom_tile" or objectType=="tile") and custom.type==2 and math.abs(shape.x-shape.z)<0.00001 then
        shape.radius=math.max(shape.x,shape.z)
    elseif custom and tostring(custom.mesh or ""):find("EFB5E7C3981EF047D8BF7F5496FE3F8463425F68",1,true)
        and tostring(custom.collider or ""):find("C7B44F6E841C611C430FFE56D4D14371CA4D1304",1,true) then
        -- Exact 32-sided XZ hull of the supplied STO PlanetCOLIDER OBJ,
        -- normalized to its bounds. Scale and collider offset are applied below.
        shape.points={{-1.000000000,-0.000000969},{-0.980800733,-0.195012724},{-0.923935785,-0.382547658},{-0.831577471,-0.555410737},{-0.707255745,-0.706959297},{-0.555732632,-0.831362641},{-0.382821093,-0.923823291},{-0.195168889,-0.980770012},{-0.000000000,-1.000000000},{0.195170420,-0.980769796},{0.382822406,-0.923822645},{0.555733726,-0.831361779},{0.707256401,-0.706958435},{0.831577909,-0.555409659},{0.923936223,-0.382546581},{0.980800733,-0.195011647},{1.000000000,-0.000000108},{0.980800733,0.195011647},{0.923936223,0.382546365},{0.831577909,0.555409659},{0.707256401,0.706958435},{0.555733726,0.831361995},{0.382822187,0.923822645},{0.195169983,0.980769581},{-0.000000219,1.000000000},{-0.195170858,0.980769581},{-0.382822843,0.923822429},{-0.555734163,0.831361564},{-0.707256839,0.706958004},{-0.831578346,0.555409013},{-0.923936660,0.382545934},{-0.980800951,0.195011001}}
    end
    return shape
end

local function overlaps(a,ashape,b,bshape)
    local yawA,yawB=math.rad(a.yaw),math.rad(b.yaw)
    local axes={{math.cos(yawA),-math.sin(yawA)},{math.sin(yawA),math.cos(yawA)},
        {math.cos(yawB),-math.sin(yawB)},{math.sin(yawB),math.cos(yawB)}}
    local function center(p,shape,yaw)
        local ox,oz=shape.offsetX or 0,shape.offsetZ or 0
        return p.x+ox*math.cos(yaw)+oz*math.sin(yaw),p.z-ox*math.sin(yaw)+oz*math.cos(yaw)
    end
    local ax,az=center(a,ashape,yawA)
    local bx,bz=center(b,bshape,yawB)
    local dx,dz=bx-ax,bz-az
    local function extent(shape,yaw,ux,uz)
        local rightX,rightZ=math.cos(yaw),-math.sin(yaw)
        local frontX,frontZ=-math.sin(yaw),-math.cos(yaw)
        return shape.x*math.abs(ux*rightX+uz*rightZ)+shape.z*math.abs(ux*frontX+uz*frontZ)
    end
    for _,axis in ipairs(axes) do
        local ux,uz=axis[1],axis[2]
        -- Edge contact is legal. latestLegal converges on the last non-overlapping pose,
        -- so adding clearance here leaves a visible gap after a bump.
        if math.abs(dx*ux+dz*uz)>=extent(ashape,yawA,ux,uz)+extent(bshape,yawB,ux,uz) then return false end
    end
    if ashape.radius or bshape.radius or ashape.points or bshape.points then
        if ashape.radius and bshape.radius then return dx*dx+dz*dz<(ashape.radius+bshape.radius)^2 end
        local function vertices(shape,cx,cz,yaw)
            if shape.radius then return nil end
            local result={}
            for _,point in ipairs(shape.points or {{-1,-1},{1,-1},{1,1},{-1,1}}) do
                local x,z=point[1]*shape.x,point[2]*shape.z
                result[#result+1]={x=cx+x*math.cos(yaw)+z*math.sin(yaw),z=cz-x*math.sin(yaw)+z*math.cos(yaw)}
            end
            return result
        end
        local pointsA,pointsB=vertices(ashape,ax,az,yawA),vertices(bshape,bx,bz,yawB)
        local polygonAxes={}
        local function addAxes(points)
            for i,point in ipairs(points or {}) do
                local nextPoint=points[i%#points+1]
                polygonAxes[#polygonAxes+1]={nextPoint.z-point.z,point.x-nextPoint.x}
            end
        end
        addAxes(pointsA);addAxes(pointsB)
        if ashape.radius or bshape.radius then
            local cx,cz=ashape.radius and ax or bx,ashape.radius and az or bz
            local polygon=ashape.radius and pointsB or pointsA
            local nearest,best=nil,math.huge
            for _,point in ipairs(polygon) do
                local distance=(point.x-cx)^2+(point.z-cz)^2
                if distance<best then nearest,best=point,distance end
            end
            if nearest then polygonAxes[#polygonAxes+1]={nearest.x-cx,nearest.z-cz} end
        end
        local function project(shape,points,cx,cz,ux,uz)
            if shape.radius then
                local middle=cx*ux+cz*uz;local extent=shape.radius*math.sqrt(ux*ux+uz*uz)
                return middle-extent,middle+extent
            end
            local low,high=math.huge,-math.huge
            for _,point in ipairs(points) do local value=point.x*ux+point.z*uz;low=math.min(low,value);high=math.max(high,value) end
            return low,high
        end
        for _,axis in ipairs(polygonAxes) do
            local ux,uz=axis[1],axis[2]
            if ux*ux+uz*uz>0.000000000001 then
                local lowA,highA=project(ashape,pointsA,ax,az,ux,uz)
                local lowB,highB=project(bshape,pointsB,bx,bz,ux,uz)
                if highA<=lowB or highB<=lowA then return false end
            end
        end
    end
    return true
end

local function terrainKind(object)
    if not object or metadata(object) then return nil end
    local objectType=string.lower(object.type or "")
    if objectType:find("bag",1,true) or objectType:find("deck",1,true) or objectType:find("card",1,true)
        or objectType:find("dice",1,true) or objectType=="scripting" or objectType=="hand" then return nil end
    local name=object.getName and object.getName() or ""
    local description=object.getDescription and object.getDescription() or ""
    local text=string.lower(name.." "..description)
    local taggedObstacle=false
    for _,tag in ipairs(object.getTags and object.getTags() or {}) do
        local lower=string.lower(tag)
        if lower=="planet" then return "planet" end
        if lower=="mines" or lower=="minefield" then return "minefield" end
        if lower=="obstacle" or lower=="station" or lower=="echo-blocker" then taggedObstacle=true end
    end
    if text:find("planet",1,true) then return "planet" end
    if text:find("minefield",1,true) then return "minefield" end
    if taggedObstacle or text:find("this obstacle",1,true) or text:find("asteroid",1,true)
        or text:find("debris",1,true) or text:find("derelict",1,true)
        or text:find("space station",1,true) or text:find("blackhole",1,true)
        or text:find("black hole",1,true) or text:find("borg cube",1,true)
        or text:find("deep space 9",1,true) then return "obstacle" end
    return nil
end

local function terrainLabel(object,kind)
    local name=object and object.getName and object.getName() or ""
    if name=="" then name=kind=="planet" and "Planet" or (kind=="minefield" and "Minefield" or "Obstacle") end
    return name
end

local function terrainSnapshot(excluded)
    local result={}
    for _,object in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if object~=excluded then
            local kind=terrainKind(object)
            if kind then
                local p,r=object.getPosition(),object.getRotation()
                table.insert(result,{object=object,kind=kind,label=terrainLabel(object,kind),description=object.getDescription and object.getDescription() or "",pose={x=p.x,z=p.z,yaw=r.y},shape=baseShape(object)})
            end
        end
    end
    return result
end

local function latestLegal(start,move,shape,obstacles)
    local function legal(t)
        local candidate=pose(start,move,t,shape.z)
        for _,other in ipairs(obstacles) do
            if overlaps(candidate,shape,other.pose,other.shape) then return false end
        end
        return true
    end
    if legal(1) then return 1,nil end
    local finalPose=pose(start,move,1,shape.z)
    local blocker=nil
    for _,other in ipairs(obstacles) do
        if overlaps(finalPose,shape,other.pose,other.shape) then
            blocker=other.reason or "overlap"
            if blocker=="planet" then break end
        end
    end
    local step=1/40
    for i=39,0,-1 do
        local low=i*step
        if legal(low) then
            local high=low+step
            -- Refine in table units, including the sweep of rotating corners.
            -- Always return the legal side of the bracket: no added clearance
            -- and no collider penetration, even on a long or curved maneuver.
            local radius=math.sqrt((shape.x+math.abs(shape.offsetX or 0))^2+(shape.z+math.abs(shape.offsetZ or 0))^2)
            for _=1,24 do
                local a,b=pose(start,move,low,shape.z),pose(start,move,high,shape.z)
                local dx,dz=b.x-a.x,b.z-a.z
                local remaining=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)+radius*math.rad(math.abs(b.yaw-a.yaw))
                if remaining<=0.00001 then break end
                local mid=(low+high)/2
                if legal(mid) then low=mid else high=mid end
            end
            return low,blocker
        end
    end
    return 0,blocker
end

local function movementTerrainHits(start,move,stop,shipShape,terrain)
    local hits={}
    local finalPose=pose(start,move,stop,shipShape.z)
    local samples=math.max(1,math.ceil(80*stop))
    local reverse=(move.forward or 0)<0 and -1 or 1
    local moving=math.abs(move.forward or 0)>0.001 or math.abs(move.side or 0)>0.001
    for _,item in ipairs(terrain or {}) do
        if item.kind~="planet" then
            local startsOn=overlaps(start,shipShape,item.pose,item.shape)
            local finalOn=overlaps(finalPose,shipShape,item.pose,item.shape)
            local templateOn=false
            -- A ship may leave an obstacle it began on without retriggering it.
            if moving and not (startsOn and not finalOn) then
                for i=1,samples do
                    local t=stop*i/samples
                    local q=pose(start,move,t,shipShape.z)
                    local heading=math.rad(q.yaw)
                    local forwardX,forwardZ=-math.sin(heading),-math.cos(heading)
                    local attachment=reverse*shipShape.z*(1-2*t)
                    local templatePose={x=q.x+forwardX*attachment,z=q.z+forwardZ*attachment,yaw=q.yaw}
                    if overlaps(templatePose,{x=0.24,z=0.12},item.pose,item.shape) then templateOn=true;break end
                end
            end
            if finalOn or templateOn then
                item.finalOverlap=finalOn
                item.templateOverlap=templateOn
                table.insert(hits,item)
            end
        end
    end
    return hits
end

STA2E.Movement={pose=pose,overlaps=overlaps,latestLegal=latestLegal}

-- Shared measurement geometry. Range, base-edge distance, and firing-arc
-- validation deliberately remain separate operations.
local RANGE_SEGMENT=3.94 -- visual TTS-unit guide; compare with the physical ruler
local MeasurementGeometry={}

local function rotatePoint(x,z,yaw)
    local angle=math.rad(yaw or 0)
    return x*math.cos(angle)+z*math.sin(angle),-x*math.sin(angle)+z*math.cos(angle)
end

local function footprintDefinition(s,object)
    local class,ship
    if s then class,ship=definition(s.definitionId) end
    local configured=(ship and ship.measurementFootprint) or (class and class.measurementFootprint)
    if configured then return copy(configured) end
    local shape=baseShape(object)
    return {kind="rectangle",halfWidth=shape.x,halfLength=shape.z,source=(ship and ship.integratedBase) and "unique-collider-bounds" or "base-bounds"}
end

function MeasurementGeometry.boundary(subject)
    local s=type(subject)=="table" and subject.instanceId and subject or nil
    local object=s and member(s,"base") or subject
    if s then
        local class,ship=definition(s.definitionId)
        local specialName=string.lower((s.name or "").." "..(ship and ship.class or ""))
        local useModel=(ship and ship.measurementObject=="model") or (class and class.measurementObject=="model") or
            (class and class.arc=="360" and (specialName:find("borg",1,true) or specialName:find("cube",1,true) or specialName:find("starbase",1,true)))
        if useModel and member(s,"model") then object=member(s,"model") end
    end
    if not object then return nil end
    local p,r=object.getPosition(),object.getRotation()
    local footprint=footprintDefinition(s,object)
    local localPoints={}
    if footprint.kind=="circle" then
        local radius=tonumber(footprint.radius) or 1
        for i=0,31 do local a=math.pi*2*i/32;table.insert(localPoints,{x=math.cos(a)*radius,z=math.sin(a)*radius}) end
    elseif footprint.kind=="polygon" and footprint.points then
        for _,point in ipairs(footprint.points) do table.insert(localPoints,{x=point.x or point[1],z=point.z or point[2]}) end
    else
        local hx=tonumber(footprint.halfWidth) or 1.4
        local hz=tonumber(footprint.halfLength) or 1.4
        localPoints={{x=-hx,z=-hz},{x=hx,z=-hz},{x=hx,z=hz},{x=-hx,z=hz}}
        footprint.halfWidth,footprint.halfLength=hx,hz
    end
    local points={}
    for _,point in ipairs(localPoints) do
        local x,z=rotatePoint(point.x,point.z,r.y)
        table.insert(points,{x=p.x+x,z=p.z+z})
    end
    return {object=object,ship=s,center={x=p.x,z=p.z},yaw=r.y,points=points,footprint=footprint}
end

local function pointInPolygon(point,polygon)
    local inside=false
    local j=#polygon
    for i=1,#polygon do
        local a,b=polygon[i],polygon[j]
        if ((a.z>point.z)~=(b.z>point.z)) and point.x<(b.x-a.x)*(point.z-a.z)/((b.z-a.z)~=0 and (b.z-a.z) or 0.000001)+a.x then inside=not inside end
        j=i
    end
    return inside
end

local function closestPointOnSegment(point,a,b)
    local dx,dz=b.x-a.x,b.z-a.z
    local length=dx*dx+dz*dz
    local t=length>0 and ((point.x-a.x)*dx+(point.z-a.z)*dz)/length or 0
    t=math.max(0,math.min(1,t))
    return {x=a.x+dx*t,z=a.z+dz*t}
end

local function segmentIntersection(a,b,c,d)
    local rX,rZ=b.x-a.x,b.z-a.z
    local sX,sZ=d.x-c.x,d.z-c.z
    local cross=rX*sZ-rZ*sX
    if math.abs(cross)<0.000001 then return nil end
    local qX,qZ=c.x-a.x,c.z-a.z
    local t=(qX*sZ-qZ*sX)/cross
    local u=(qX*rZ-qZ*rX)/cross
    if t>=0 and t<=1 and u>=0 and u<=1 then return {x=a.x+t*rX,z=a.z+t*rZ} end
    return nil
end

function MeasurementGeometry.nearestPoints(a,b)
    if not a or not b then return nil end
    if pointInPolygon(a.points[1],b.points) or pointInPolygon(b.points[1],a.points) then
        return {distance=0,from=a.points[1],to=a.points[1]}
    end
    for i,point in ipairs(a.points) do
        local nextPoint=a.points[i%#a.points+1]
        for j,other in ipairs(b.points) do
            local crossing=segmentIntersection(point,nextPoint,other,b.points[j%#b.points+1])
            if crossing then return {distance=0,from=crossing,to=crossing} end
        end
    end
    local best={distance=math.huge}
    local function consider(point,polygon,reverse)
        for i=1,#polygon do
            local q=closestPointOnSegment(point,polygon[i],polygon[i%#polygon+1])
            local dx,dz=point.x-q.x,point.z-q.z
            local distance=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)
            if distance<best.distance then
                best={distance=distance,from=reverse and q or point,to=reverse and point or q}
            end
        end
    end
    for _,point in ipairs(a.points) do consider(point,b.points,false) end
    for _,point in ipairs(b.points) do consider(point,a.points,true) end
    return best
end

local function worldToLocal(boundary,point)
    local dx,dz=point.x-boundary.center.x,point.z-boundary.center.z
    return rotatePoint(dx,dz,-boundary.yaw)
end

local function targetSamples(boundary)
    local samples={}
    for i,point in ipairs(boundary.points) do
        table.insert(samples,point)
        local nextPoint=boundary.points[i%#boundary.points+1]
        table.insert(samples,{x=(point.x+nextPoint.x)/2,z=(point.z+nextPoint.z)/2})
    end
    table.insert(samples,boundary.center)
    return samples
end

local function pointInPrintedArc(attacker,point,halfAngle,rear,originHalfWidth,originForwardOffset)
    local lx,lz=worldToLocal(attacker,point)
    local forward=rear and lz or -lz
    local fp=attacker.footprint
    local hx=fp.halfWidth or baseShape(attacker.object).x
    local hz=fp.halfLength or baseShape(attacker.object).z
    if forward<hz-0.01 then return false end
    if halfAngle>=89.9 then return true end
    local originWidth=originHalfWidth
    if originWidth==nil then originWidth=hx end
    local originForward=originForwardOffset
    if originForward==nil then originForward=hz end
    return math.abs(lx)<=originWidth+(forward-originForward)*math.tan(math.rad(halfAngle))+0.01
end

function MeasurementGeometry.validateArc(attacker,target,profile)
    if not attacker or not target then return {primary=false} end
    profile=profile or "90"
    if profile=="360" then return {primary=true,profile=profile} end
    local primaryHalf=profile:match("^180") and 90 or 45
    local result={primary=false,rear=false,secondary=false,profile=profile}
    for _,point in ipairs(targetSamples(target)) do
        if pointInPrintedArc(attacker,point,primaryHalf,false) then result.primary=true end
        if profile:find("rear90",1,true) and pointInPrintedArc(attacker,point,45,true) then result.rear=true end
        -- The narrow front secondary arc converges at the actual base center;
        -- it must inherit neither the width nor the forward edge of the base.
        if profile:find("second30",1,true) and pointInPrintedArc(attacker,point,15,false,0,0) then result.secondary=true end
    end
    return result
end

function MeasurementGeometry.measure(attackerShip,targetShip)
    local attacker=MeasurementGeometry.boundary(attackerShip)
    local target=MeasurementGeometry.boundary(targetShip)
    if not attacker or not target then return nil end
    local nearest=MeasurementGeometry.nearestPoints(attacker,target)
    local class=definition(attackerShip.definitionId)
    local arcs=MeasurementGeometry.validateArc(attacker,target,class and class.arc or "90")
    local dx,dz=target.center.x-attacker.center.x,target.center.z-attacker.center.z
    return {
        centerDistance=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz),
        baseEdgeDistance=nearest.distance,
        nearest=nearest,
        range=nearest.distance<=0.02 and 0 or math.ceil(nearest.distance/RANGE_SEGMENT),
        arcs=arcs,
        attackerBoundary=attacker,
        targetBoundary=target,
    }
end

STA2E.MeasurementGeometry=MeasurementGeometry

function STA2E_ReportMeasurements(s,color)
    local found=0
    for id,target in pairs(STA2E.ships) do
        if id~=s.instanceId and member(target,"base") then
            local result=MeasurementGeometry.measure(s,target)
            if result then
                found=found+1
                local arc=result.arcs.primary and "PRIMARY" or (result.arcs.rear and "REAR" or (result.arcs.secondary and "SECONDARY" or "OUT OF ARC"))
                local range=result.range<=3 and ("Range "..result.range) or "Beyond Range 3"
                tell(color,string.format("%s → %s: %s, %.2f base-edge units, %s.",s.name,target.name,range,result.baseEdgeDistance,arc))
            end
        end
    end
    if found==0 then tell(color,"No other deployed ship bases are available to measure.") end
end

local function executeMove(s,color,manualKey)
    if not complete(s) then tell(color,"Deploy / Repair this ship first.");return end
    local key=manualKey or s.state.maneuver
    local move=key and MOVE_DEFS[key]
    if not move then tell(color,"No movement template for "..tostring(key)..".");return end
    if STA2E.pendingMoves[s.instanceId] then tell(color,"This ship is already moving.");return end
    if not manualKey and s.state.status~="revealed" then tell(color,"Reveal the maneuver before executing.");return end
    local base=member(s,"base")
    local p,r=base.getPosition(),base.getRotation()
    local start={x=p.x,z=p.z,yaw=r.y}
    local shipShape=baseShape(base)
    local terrain=terrainSnapshot(base)
    local obstacles={}
    for id,other in pairs(STA2E.ships) do
        if id~=s.instanceId then
            local otherBase=member(other,"base")
            if otherBase then
                local op,orot=otherBase.getPosition(),otherBase.getRotation()
                table.insert(obstacles,{pose={x=op.x,z=op.z,yaw=orot.y},shape=baseShape(otherBase),reason="ship"})
            end
        end
    end
    -- Planets only forbid the final landing. Including them in the endpoint
    -- backtracking test still permits a maneuver that passes completely through.
    for _,item in ipairs(terrain) do
        if item.kind=="planet" then table.insert(obstacles,{pose=item.pose,shape=item.shape,reason="planet",label=item.label}) end
    end
    local stop,stopReason=latestLegal(start,move,shipShape,obstacles)
    local terrainHits=movementTerrainHits(start,move,stop,shipShape,terrain)
    s.undo={position={p.x,p.y,p.z},rotation={r.x,r.y,r.z},state=copy(s.state),round=STA2E.game.round}
    STA2E.pendingMoves[s.instanceId]=true
    local wasLocked=base.getLock()
    base.setLock(true)
    local frames=math.max(1,math.ceil(stop*30*(move.segments and #move.segments or 1)))
    local frame=0
    local function animate()
        if not obj(base.getGUID()) or not STA2E.ships[s.instanceId] then STA2E.pendingMoves[s.instanceId]=nil;return end
        frame=frame+1
        local q=pose(start,move,stop*frame/frames,shipShape.z)
        base.setPosition({q.x,p.y,q.z})
        base.setRotation({r.x,q.yaw,r.z})
        sync(s)
        if frame<frames then Wait.frames(animate,1) else
            base.setLock(wasLocked)
            STA2E.pendingMoves[s.instanceId]=nil
            STA2E_FollowModel(s)
            if manualKey then
                -- Card/immediate maneuvers are independent movement effects.
                -- Preserve the ship's planned maneuver and its phase status.
                s.state.toolsPage="home"
            else
                s.state.status=(stopReason=="planet" or #terrainHits>0) and "complete" or "action"
                s.state.modifyOpen=false
            end
            s.state.lastMoveBlocked=stop<0.999 or #terrainHits>0
            if not manualKey then
                local finishPosition,finishRotation=base.getPosition(),base.getRotation()
                STA2E_RecordPublicMove(s,key,start,{x=finishPosition.x,z=finishPosition.z,yaw=finishRotation.y})
            end
            if not manualKey and STA2E_AI_AfterMove then STA2E_AI_AfterMove(s,key) end
            refresh(s)
            local verb=manualKey and " has performed an immediate maneuver of " or " has executed its planned maneuver of "
            local stopText=stop<0.999 and (stopReason=="planet" and " (moved back to clear a planet)." or " (stopped at ship overlap).") or "."
            broadcastToAll(s.name..verb..maneuverLabel(s,key)..stopText,{0.82,0.90,1})
            if stopReason=="planet" then
                broadcastToAll("[PLANET] "..s.name.." cannot end its maneuver overlapping a planet: move back to the nearest legal position and skip Perform Action.",{1.0,0.72,0.28})
            end
            for _,item in ipairs(terrainHits) do
                local contact=item.finalOverlap and item.templateOverlap and "template and final base overlap" or (item.finalOverlap and "final base overlaps" or "template passes over")
                if item.kind=="minefield" then
                    broadcastToAll("[MINEFIELD] "..s.name.." - "..contact.." "..item.label..". Resolve the effect of the card that placed the Minefield Token.",{1.0,0.55,0.35})
                else
                    broadcastToAll("[OBSTACLE] "..s.name.." - "..contact.." "..item.label..". Skip Perform Action; roll 1 attack die and suffer any Hit or Critical Hit rolled.",{1.0,0.72,0.28})
                end
                if item.description and item.description~="" then broadcastToAll(item.label..": "..item.description,{0.88,0.82,0.65}) end
            end
        end
    end
    animate()
end

-- Scenario movement uses the same geometry and overlap rules as fleet ships.
local scenarioMoving={}
function STA2E_ScenarioMove(params)
    local base=params and obj(params.guid)
    if not base or not base.call then return false end
    local h=base.call("getHull")
    local mission=STA2E.game and STA2E.game.alliance
    if not h or not mission or not mission.active or h.runId~=mission.runId or h.missionId~=mission.missionId or h.destroyed then return false end
    local allowed={}
    if h.kind=="freighter" then allowed={S2=true,S3=true,BL2=true,BR2=true}
    elseif h.kind=="runabout" or h.kind=="tenthFleet" then
        local speeds=h.kind=="runabout" and {1,2} or {2,3}
        for _,speed in ipairs(speeds) do for _,bearing in ipairs({"TL","BL","S","BR","TR"}) do allowed[bearing..speed]=true end end
    end
    local key=params.key;local move=allowed[key] and MOVE_DEFS[key]
    if not move or scenarioMoving[params.guid] then return false end
    local p,r=base.getPosition(),base.getRotation()
    local start={x=p.x,z=p.z,yaw=r.y};local shape=baseShape(base)
    local obstacles={};local seen={}
    local function obstacle(other)
        if other and other~=base and not seen[other.getGUID()] then
            seen[other.getGUID()]=true
            local op,rot=other.getPosition(),other.getRotation()
            obstacles[#obstacles+1]={pose={x=op.x,z=op.z,yaw=rot.y},shape=baseShape(other),reason="ship"}
        end
    end
    for _,s in pairs(STA2E.ships) do obstacle(member(s,"base")) end
    for guid,row in pairs((mission.missionObjects or {}).hullObjects or {}) do
        if row.kind=="runabout" or row.kind=="freighter" or row.kind=="tenthFleet" then obstacle(obj(guid)) end
    end
    local terrain=terrainSnapshot(base)
    for _,item in ipairs(terrain) do if item.kind=="planet" then obstacles[#obstacles+1]={pose=item.pose,shape=item.shape,reason="planet"} end end
    local stop=latestLegal(start,move,shape,obstacles)
    local hits=movementTerrainHits(start,move,stop,shape,terrain)
    local wasLocked=base.getLock();base.setLock(true);scenarioMoving[params.guid]=true
    local frame=0;local frames=math.max(1,math.ceil(stop*30*(move.segments and #move.segments or 1)))
    local function animate()
        if not obj(params.guid) then scenarioMoving[params.guid]=nil;return end
        frame=frame+1;local q=pose(start,move,stop*frame/frames,shape.z)
        base.setPosition({q.x,p.y,q.z});base.setRotation({r.x,q.yaw,r.z})
        if frame<frames then Wait.frames(animate,1) else
            scenarioMoving[params.guid]=nil;base.setLock(wasLocked)
            broadcastToAll(h.label.." performed "..key..(stop<0.999 and " (stopped to clear overlap)." or "."),{0.82,0.90,1})
            for _,item in ipairs(hits) do broadcastToAll("[OBSTACLE] "..h.label..": resolve "..item.label.." overlap effects manually.",{1,0.72,0.28}) end
        end
    end
    animate();return true
end

local function modify(s,color,key)
    if s.state.status~="revealed" then tell(color,"Reveal a maneuver before modifying it.");return end
    key=tostring(key or ""):upper():gsub("%s+","")
    if not MOVE_DEFS[key] then tell(color,"Unknown movement template: "..key);return end
    s.state.maneuver=key
    s.state.modifyOpen=true
    refresh(s)
    broadcastToAll(s.name.." modifies maneuver to "..key..".",{0.82,0.90,1})
end

function STA2E_ModifyChoice(player,value,id)
    if not player then return end
    local color=player.color
    local s=STA2E.ships[STA2E.modifyShip[color]]
    if not s or s.state.status~="revealed" then STA2E.modifyShip[color]=nil;hud();return end
    if id=="modify_close" then STA2E.modifyShip[color]=nil;hud();return end
    local key
    if id=="modify_restore" then key=s.state.revealedOriginal
    elseif id=="modify_up" or id=="modify_down" then
        local prefix,speed=(s.state.maneuver or ""):match("^([A-Z]+)(%d+)$")
        if prefix then key=prefix..tostring(tonumber(speed)+(id=="modify_up" and 1 or -1)) end
    else key=id and id:match("^modify_([A-Z]+%d+)$") end
    if not key then tell(color,"No matching maneuver for that adjustment.");return end
    if not MOVE_DEFS[key] then tell(color,"No "..key.." movement template is available.");return end
    STA2E.modifyShip[color]=nil
    modify(s,color,key)
end

function STA2E_SetManeuver(params)
    local s=shipFor(params.object)
    if not s then return end
    modify(s,params.color,params.key)
end

local oldCommand=STA2E_Command
function STA2E_Command(params)
    local s=shipFor(params.object)
    local cmd=params.command or ""
    if not s then return oldCommand(params) end
    if STA2E.pendingMoves[s.instanceId] then tell(params.color,"Wait for this ship's movement to finish.");return end
    if cmd=="move" then executeMove(s,params.color);return end
    if cmd=="reveal" then
        if s.state.maneuver then s.state.revealedOriginal=s.state.maneuver end
        oldCommand(params);return
    end
    if cmd=="modify_toggle" then
        if s.state.status~="revealed" then tell(params.color,"Reveal a maneuver before modifying it.");return end
        STA2E.modifyShip[params.color]=s.instanceId
        hud();return
    end
    if cmd=="modify_restore" then modify(s,params.color,s.state.revealedOriginal);return end
    if cmd=="modify_up" or cmd=="modify_down" then
        local prefix,speed=(s.state.maneuver or ""):match("^([A-Z]+)(%d+)$")
        local delta=cmd=="modify_up" and 1 or -1
        if prefix then modify(s,params.color,prefix..tostring(tonumber(speed)+delta)) end
        return
    end
    if cmd=="mark_fired" then s.state.fired=not s.state.fired;refresh(s);return end
    oldCommand(params)
end

function GUIDE_COLORS.forShip(subject)

local function normalizeDialPhase(s)
    s.state=s.state or {status="planning"}
    if STA2E.game.phase~="planning" and s.state.status=="planning" and s.state.maneuver then
        s.state.status="neutral";s.state.toolsPage=s.state.toolsPage or "home"
        return true
    end
    if (STA2E.game.phase=="combat" or STA2E.game.phase=="end") and not s.state.toolsPage then
        s.state.toolsPage="home"
        return true
    end
    if s.state.maneuver then return false end
    local natural=STA2E.game.phase=="planning" and "planning" or "neutral"
    if s.state.status=="planning" or s.state.status=="neutral" then
        if s.state.status~=natural then
            s.state.status=natural
            s.state.toolsPage=natural=="neutral" and "home" or nil
            return true
        end
        if natural=="neutral" and not s.state.toolsPage then s.state.toolsPage="home";return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function edgeRoundedRange(hx,hz,d,y,color)
    local points={}
    for _,corner in ipairs({{hx,-hz,-90},{hx,hz,0},{-hx,hz,90},{-hx,-hz,180}}) do
        for step=0,12 do
            local angle=math.rad(corner[3]+step*90/12)
            table.insert(points,{corner[1]+math.cos(angle)*d,y,corner[2]+math.sin(angle)*d})
        end
    end
    table.insert(points,points[1])
    return {points=points,color=color,thickness=RANGE_LINE_THICKNESS}
end

local function arcRangeBand(halfAngle,rear,distance,y,hx,hz,originWidth,originZ)
    local direction=rear and 1 or -1
    local edgeZ=rear and hz or -hz
    local farZ=edgeZ+direction*distance
    local raw={}
    local steps=18
    for step=0,steps do
        local angle=math.rad(step*90/steps)
        table.insert(raw,{-hx-distance*math.cos(angle),y,edgeZ+direction*distance*math.sin(angle)})
    end
    for step=1,steps do table.insert(raw,{-hx+(2*hx*step/steps),y,farZ}) end
    for step=1,steps do
        local angle=math.rad(step*90/steps)
        table.insert(raw,{hx+distance*math.sin(angle),y,edgeZ+direction*distance*math.cos(angle)})
    end
    if halfAngle>=89.9 then
        -- A 180-degree arc is divided at the base centerline. Extend each
        -- edge-measured contour back to that line before drawing the curve.
        if math.abs(originZ-edgeZ)>0.001 then
            table.insert(raw,1,{-hx-distance,y,originZ})
            table.insert(raw,{hx+distance,y,originZ})
        end
        return raw
    end
    local points={}
    local slope=math.tan(math.rad(halfAngle))
    for _,point in ipairs(raw) do
        local forward=(point[3]-originZ)*direction
        if forward>=-0.001 and math.abs(point[1])<=originWidth+slope*forward+0.001 then table.insert(points,point) end
    end
    return points
end

local function arcProjection(halfAngle,center,ranges,y,colors,hx,hz,originHalfWidth,originForwardOffset)
    local rear=math.abs(center-180)<1
    local originWidth=originHalfWidth
    if originWidth==nil then originWidth=hx end
    local originForward=originForwardOffset
    if originForward==nil then originForward=hz end
    local originZ=rear and originForward or -originForward
    local lines={}
    local bands={}
    for n,distance in ipairs(ranges) do bands[n]=arcRangeBand(halfAngle,rear,distance,y,hx,hz,originWidth,originZ) end
    local outer=bands[#bands]
    if #outer>=2 then
        local outline={{-originWidth,y,originZ}}
        for _,point in ipairs(outer) do table.insert(outline,point) end
        table.insert(outline,{originWidth,y,originZ})
        table.insert(lines,{points=outline,color=colors[#ranges],thickness=ARC_LINE_THICKNESS})
    end
    for n=1,#ranges-1 do
        if #bands[n]>=2 then table.insert(lines,{points=bands[n],color=colors[n],thickness=ARC_LINE_THICKNESS}) end
    end
    return lines
end

drawShipGuides=function(s)
    local base=member(s,"base")
    if not base then return end
    local lines={}
    local state=s.state or {}
    local range=tonumber(state.guideRange) or 0
    if range>0 or state.guideArc then
        local bounds=base.getBoundsNormalized()
        local size=bounds and bounds.size or {x=2.8,z=2.8}
        local scale=base.getScale()
        local sx=math.max(0.01,scale and scale.x or 1)
        local sy=math.max(0.01,scale and scale.y or 1)
        local sz=math.max(0.01,scale and scale.z or 1)
        local hx,hz=size.x/(2*sx),size.z/(2*sz)
        -- The collider can be much lower than the visible base top. Use the
        -- renderer bounds so these guides sit above the printed base surface.
        local visual=base.getVisualBoundsNormalized()
        local visualSize=visual and visual.size or size
        local top=(visual and visual.offset and visual.offset.y or 0)+(visualSize.y or 0.4)/2
        local y=STA2E_Playtest.guideY(base)
        local bandColor=GUIDE_COLORS.forShip(s)
        for n=1,math.min(3,range) do
            table.insert(lines,edgeRoundedRange(hx,hz,n*RANGE_SEGMENT/((sx+sz)/2),y,bandColor[n]))
        end
        if state.guideArc then
            local class=definition(s.definitionId)
            local profile=class and class.arc or "90"
            local ranges={}
            for n=1,3 do ranges[n]=n*RANGE_SEGMENT/((sx+sz)/2) end
            local function addArc(half,center,originHalfWidth,originForwardOffset)
                for _,line in ipairs(arcProjection(half,center,ranges,y,bandColor,hx,hz,originHalfWidth,originForwardOffset)) do table.insert(lines,line) end
            end
            if profile=="360" then
                for n=1,3 do table.insert(lines,edgeRoundedRange(hx,hz,ranges[n],y,bandColor[n])) end
            else
                if profile:match("^180") then addArc(90,0,nil,0) else addArc(45,0) end
                if profile:find("rear90",1,true) then addArc(45,180) end
                -- The 30-degree secondary arc is centered on the ship and its
                -- boundary rays converge at the base center, not its front edge.
                if profile:find("second30",1,true) then addArc(15,0,0,0) end
            end
        end
    end
    base.setVectorLines(lines)
end
STA2E_DrawShipGuides=drawShipGuides

local phaseCommand=STA2E_Command
function STA2E_Command(params)
    local cmd=params.command or ""
    local controlled=shipFor(params.object)
    if controlled then
        if cmd=="quick_arc" then
            if controlled.state.guideArc or (controlled.state.guideRange or 0)>0 then controlled.state.guideArc=false;controlled.state.guideRange=0
            else controlled.state.guideArc=true end
            drawShipGuides(controlled);refresh(controlled);return
        end
        if cmd=="toggle_actions" then controlled.state.cardMenuOpen=not (controlled.state.cardMenuOpen==true);refresh(controlled);return end
        if cmd=="card_close" then controlled.state.cardMenuOpen=false;refresh(controlled);return end
        if cmd:sub(1,11)=="card_token_" then
            local key=cmd:sub(12)
            if ACTION_BAGS[key] then spawnActionToken(controlled,key);refresh(controlled) end
            return
        end
        if cmd=="card_echo" then
            if STA2E_StartSensorEcho then STA2E_StartSensorEcho({color=params.color,instanceId=controlled.instanceId,source=params.object,sourceType="card"}) end
            return
        end
    end
    if cmd:sub(1,5)~="tool_" then return phaseCommand(params) end
    local s=controlled
    if not s then return end
    if cmd=="tool_close" or cmd=="tool_phase" then
        s.state.toolsPage=nil
    elseif cmd=="tool_home" then
        s.state.toolsPage="home"
    elseif cmd=="tool_tokens" then
        s.state.toolsPage="tokens"
    elseif cmd=="tool_moves" then
        s.state.toolsPage="moves";s.state.toolsMovePage=1
    elseif cmd=="tool_arcs" then
        s.state.toolsPage="arcs"
    elseif cmd=="tool_dice" then
        tell(params.color,"Dice controls are disabled for this release.")
    elseif cmd=="tool_damage" then
        s.state.toolsPage="damage"
    elseif cmd=="tool_prev" then
        s.state.toolsMovePage=math.max(1,(s.state.toolsMovePage or 1)-1)
    elseif cmd=="tool_next" then
        s.state.toolsMovePage=(s.state.toolsMovePage or 1)+1
    elseif cmd=="tool_undo" then
        phaseCommand({object=params.object,color=params.color,command="undo"});return
    elseif cmd=="tool_arc_toggle" then
        s.state.guideArc=not s.state.guideArc;drawShipGuides(s)
    elseif cmd=="tool_clear_guides" then
        s.state.guideArc=false;s.state.guideRange=0;drawShipGuides(s)
    elseif cmd:match("^tool_range_[123]$") then
        s.state.guideRange=tonumber(cmd:sub(-1));drawShipGuides(s)
    elseif cmd=="tool_measure" then
        if STA2E_ReportMeasurements then STA2E_ReportMeasurements(s,params.color) end
    elseif cmd:sub(1,11)=="tool_token_" then
        local key=cmd:sub(12)
        if not ACTION_BAGS[key] then tell(params.color,"That token bag is unavailable.");return end
        spawnActionToken(s,key)
    elseif cmd:sub(1,10)=="tool_move_" then
        local key=cmd:sub(11)
        if not MOVE_DEFS[key] then tell(params.color,"Unknown maneuver.");return end
        executeMove(s,params.color,key);return
    else return end
    refresh(s)
end

function STA2E_AllianceActivateAI(params)

    if STA2E.pendingMoves[s.instanceId] then return end

    -- that exact control path when installed; the local selector below remains
    -- a safe fallback for saves that only have the mission framework.

-- Physical dice detection with a logical result lock. Once captured, incidental
-- movement of the physical die cannot alter the recorded combat result.
local DICE_ZONE_COLORS={d1ce01="Blue",d1ce02="Red"}
local ATTACK_FACES={"Blank","Hit","Crit","Battle Stations"}
local DEFENSE_FACES={"Blank","Evade","Battle Stations"}
local DiceManager={byGuid={},watching={}}

local function dieType(object)
    if not object or (object.type~="Custom_Dice" and object.type~="Dice") then return nil end
    local values=object.getRotationValues and object.getRotationValues() or {}
    local hasAttack,hasDefense=false,false
    for _,entry in ipairs(values or {}) do
        local value=string.lower(tostring(entry.value or entry.Value or ""))
        if value=="hit" or value=="crit" or value=="critical" then hasAttack=true end
        if value=="evade" then hasDefense=true end
    end
    if hasAttack then return "attack" end
    if hasDefense then return "defense" end
    local tags=object.getTags and object.getTags() or {}
    for _,tag in ipairs(tags) do
        if tag=="STA2E_ATTACK_DIE" then return "attack" end
        if tag=="STA2E_DEFENSE_DIE" then return "defense" end
    end
    return nil
end

local function normalizeDieResult(value,kind)
    local text=tostring(value or "Blank")
    local lower=string.lower(text):gsub("[%s_-]","")
    local numeric={
        attack={ ["1"]="Crit",["2"]="Blank",["3"]="Hit",["4"]="Blank",["5"]="Battle Stations",["6"]="Hit",["7"]="Battle Stations",["8"]="Hit" },
        defense={ ["1"]="Evade",["2"]="Blank",["3"]="Evade",["4"]="Battle Stations",["5"]="Blank",["6"]="Evade",["7"]="Battle Stations",["8"]="Blank" },
    }
    if numeric[kind] and numeric[kind][text] then return numeric[kind][text] end
    local names={blank="Blank",hit="Hit",crit="Crit",critical="Crit",evade="Evade",battlestation="Battle Stations",battlestations="Battle Stations"}
    local result=names[lower] or text
    local legal=kind=="attack" and ATTACK_FACES or DEFENSE_FACES
    for _,face in ipairs(legal) do if face==result then return result end end
    return "Blank"
end

local function setDieSelected(die,selected)
    if not die then return end
    die.selected=selected==true
    local object=obj(die.guid)
    if not object then return end
    if die.selected then object.highlightOn({1.0,0.82,0.12},0)
    else object.highlightOff() end
end

local function clearDiceSelection(pool)
    for _,guid in ipairs(pool.order or {}) do setDieSelected(pool.dice[guid],false) end
end

local function dicePool(color)
    STA2E.dice=STA2E.dice or {}
    STA2E.dice[color]=STA2E.dice[color] or {dice={},order={},rolling={},revision=0,finalized=false}
    STA2E.dice[color].rolling=STA2E.dice[color].rolling or {}
    return STA2E.dice[color]
end

function DiceManager.remove(color,guid)
    local pool=dicePool(color)
    local die=pool.dice[guid]
    if die then setDieSelected(die,false) end
    local object=obj(guid)
    if object then object.setLock(false) end
    pool.dice[guid]=nil;pool.rolling[guid]=nil
    for i=#pool.order,1,-1 do if pool.order[i]==guid then table.remove(pool.order,i) end end
    if DiceManager.byGuid[guid]==die then DiceManager.byGuid[guid]=nil end
    DiceManager.watching[guid]=nil
    pool.revision=(pool.revision or 0)+1
    if #pool.order==0 then pool.kind=nil;pool.finalized=false end
end

function DiceManager.pending(pool)
    if next(pool.rolling) then return true end
    for _,die in pairs(pool.dice) do if die.awaiting then return true end end
    return false
end

local function diceSummary(color)
    local pool=dicePool(color)
    local values={}
    for _,guid in ipairs(pool.order) do
        local die=pool.dice[guid]
        if die and not die.awaiting then
            local result=die.result=="Battle Stations" and "Battlestation" or die.result
            table.insert(values,result)
        end
    end
    local kind=pool.kind=="defense" and "defense" or "attack"
    local noun=#values==1 and "die" or "dice"
    return color.." rolled "..#values.." "..kind.." "..noun.." and got "..table.concat(values,", ").."."
end

local function rotateDieToResult(die,result)
    local object=die and obj(die.guid)
    if not object then return false end
    for _,entry in ipairs(object.getRotationValues and object.getRotationValues() or {}) do
        local value=entry.value or entry.Value
        if normalizeDieResult(value,die.kind)==result then
            local rotation=entry.rotation or entry.Rotation
            if rotation then object.setRotationSmooth(rotation,false,true);return true end
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function arrangeDicePool(color)
    local pool=dicePool(color)
    local zoneGuid=color=="Blue" and "d1ce01" or "d1ce02"
    local zone=obj(zoneGuid)
    if not zone then return end
    local center,rotation=zone.getPosition(),zone.getRotation()
    local angle=math.rad(rotation.y or 0)
    local rightX,rightZ=math.cos(angle),-math.sin(angle)
    local spacing=1.55
    local count=#pool.order
    local arrangeRevision=pool.revision or 0
    for i,guid in ipairs(pool.order) do
        local object=obj(guid)
        if object then
            local dieGuid=guid
            local offset=(i-(count+1)/2)*spacing
            local current=object.getPosition()
            object.setLock(false)
            object.setPositionSmooth({center.x+rightX*offset,current.y,center.z+rightZ*offset},false,true)
            Wait.frames(function()
                local settled=obj(dieGuid)
                local active=dicePool(color)
                if settled and active.revision==arrangeRevision and active.dice[dieGuid] then settled.setLock(true) end
            end,25)
        end
    end
end

local function finishDiceBatch(color)
    local pool=dicePool(color)
    if next(pool.rolling) then return end
    local revision=pool.revision or 0
    Wait.frames(function()
        local current=dicePool(color)
        if current.revision~=revision or next(current.rolling) or current.finalized then return end
        arrangeDicePool(color)
        broadcastToAll(diceSummary(color),color=="Blue" and {0.25,0.65,1} or {1,0.35,0.35})
        hud()
    end,20)
end

function DiceManager.capture(object,color)
    local kind=dieType(object)
    if not kind or not own(color) then return end
    local guid=object.getGUID()
    local pool=dicePool(color)
    if pool.finalized or not pool.rolling[guid] then return end
    pool.kind=kind
    local die=pool.dice[guid] or {guid=guid,kind=kind,selected=false}
    die.result=normalizeDieResult(object.getValue and object.getValue() or "Blank",kind)
    die.awaiting=false
    die.color=color
    pool.dice[guid]=die
    DiceManager.byGuid[guid]=die
    object.setLock(true)
    pool.rolling[guid]=nil
    pool.revision=(pool.revision or 0)+1
    finishDiceBatch(color)
end

function DiceManager.watch(object,color,attempt)
    if not object or not obj(object.getGUID()) then return end
    local guid=object.getGUID()
    if DiceManager.watching[guid] then return end
    local watchedPool=dicePool(color)
    local watchedDie=watchedPool.dice[guid]
    local ticket={}
    DiceManager.watching[guid]=ticket
    local function poll(count)
        if DiceManager.watching[guid]~=ticket then return end
        local current=obj(guid)
        local pool=dicePool(color)
        if pool~=watchedPool or pool.dice[guid]~=watchedDie or not pool.rolling[guid] then DiceManager.watching[guid]=nil;return end
        if not current then DiceManager.remove(color,guid);finishDiceBatch(color);hud();return end
        if current.resting then
            DiceManager.watching[guid]=nil
            DiceManager.capture(current,color)
            return
        end
        if count>=360 then
            DiceManager.remove(color,guid)
            tell(color,"A die did not settle in time and was removed from the pool. Roll it again to record a result.")
            finishDiceBatch(color)
            hud()
            return
        end
        Wait.frames(function() poll(count+1) end,1)
    end
    -- Randomize events can fire before TTS clears the die's resting flag.
    -- Give physics two frames to start before testing for a settled result.
    Wait.frames(function() poll(attempt or 0) end,2)
end

function DiceManager.beginRoll(object,color)
    local kind=dieType(object)
    if not kind or not own(color) then return end
    local pool=dicePool(color)
    if pool.finalized then return end
    if pool.kind and pool.kind~=kind and #pool.order>0 then tell(color,"Finish or clear the current "..pool.kind.." pool before recording "..kind.." dice.");return end
    local guid=object.getGUID()
    if pool.rolling[guid] then return end
    local previous=DiceManager.byGuid[guid]
    if previous and previous.color~=color then
        if own(previous.color) then DiceManager.remove(previous.color,guid) else DiceManager.byGuid[guid]=nil;DiceManager.watching[guid]=nil end
    end
    pool.kind=kind
    local die=DiceManager.byGuid[guid] or {guid=guid,kind=kind,selected=false}
    setDieSelected(die,false)
    die.kind=kind;die.color=color;die.awaiting=true;die.result="Rolling…"
    if not pool.dice[guid] then table.insert(pool.order,guid) end
    pool.dice[guid]=die;DiceManager.byGuid[guid]=die
    pool.rolling[guid]=true
    pool.revision=(pool.revision or 0)+1
    STA2E.diceOpen=STA2E.diceOpen or {};STA2E.diceOpen[color]=true
    DiceManager.watch(object,color,0)
    hud()
end

function DiceManager.restore(state)
    if type(state)~="table" or state.schemaVersion~=1 then return end
    local savedPools=type(state.dice)=="table" and state.dice or {}
    local savedOpen=type(state.diceOpen)=="table" and state.diceOpen or {}
    local savedSource=type(state.diceSource)=="table" and state.diceSource or {}
    local resume={}
    for _,color in ipairs(PLAYER_COLORS) do
        local saved=savedPools[color]
        local pool=dicePool(color)
        if type(saved)=="table" and array(saved.order) and type(saved.dice)=="table" then
            for _,guid in ipairs(saved.order) do
                local die=type(guid)=="string" and saved.dice[guid]
                local object=type(guid)=="string" and obj(guid)
                local kind=object and dieType(object)
                if type(die)=="table" and kind and not DiceManager.byGuid[guid] and (not pool.kind or pool.kind==kind) then
                    local awaiting=die.awaiting==true or (type(saved.rolling)=="table" and saved.rolling[guid]==true)
                    local restored={guid=guid,kind=kind,color=color,selected=not awaiting and die.selected==true,awaiting=awaiting,result=awaiting and "Rolling…" or normalizeDieResult(die.result,kind)}
                    pool.kind=kind;pool.dice[guid]=restored;table.insert(pool.order,guid)
                    DiceManager.byGuid[guid]=restored
                    object.setLock(not awaiting);setDieSelected(restored,restored.selected)
                    if awaiting then table.insert(resume,{object=object,color=color}) end
                end
            end
            pool.finalized=saved.finalized==true and not DiceManager.pending(pool)
        end
        if type(savedOpen[color])=="boolean" then STA2E.diceOpen[color]=savedOpen[color]
        else STA2E.diceOpen[color]=#pool.order>0 end
        if type(savedSource[color])=="string" then STA2E.diceSource[color]=savedSource[color] end
    end
    for _,pending in ipairs(resume) do
        local pool=dicePool(pending.color)
        pool.rolling[pending.object.getGUID()]=true
        DiceManager.watch(pending.object,pending.color,0)
    end
end

local function diceInZoneColor(object)
    for guid,color in pairs(DICE_ZONE_COLORS) do
        local zone=obj(guid)
        if zone then for _,inside in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do if inside==object then return color end end end
    end
    return nil
end

function onObjectEnterScriptingZone(zone,object)
    local color=zone and DICE_ZONE_COLORS[zone.getGUID()]
    if color and dieType(object) then DiceManager.beginRoll(object,color) end
end

function STA2E_DieRolled(params)
    local object=params and params.object
    if not dieType(object) then return end
    local color=diceInZoneColor(object)
    if color then DiceManager.beginRoll(object,color) end
end

local function selectedDice(pool,predicate)
    local result={}
    for _,guid in ipairs(pool.order) do
        local die=pool.dice[guid]
        if die and ((predicate and predicate(die)) or (not predicate and die.selected)) then table.insert(result,die) end
    end
    return result
end

local function rerollDice(color,dice)
    for _,die in ipairs(dice) do
        local object=obj(die.guid)
        if object then
            setDieSelected(die,false)
            object.setLock(false)
            object.randomize()
            DiceManager.beginRoll(object,color)
        end
    end
end

local function consumeShipToken(color,key)
    local instance=STA2E.diceSource and STA2E.diceSource[color]
    if not instance then return false end
    local note="STA2E_SHIP_TOKEN|"..instance.."|"..key
    for _,object in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if object.getGMNotes and object.getGMNotes()==note then object.destruct();return true end
    end
    return false
end

function STA2E_DiceAction(player,value,id)
    if not player or not own(player.color) or not id then return end
    local color=player.color
    local prefix="dice_"..color.."_"
    if id:sub(1,#prefix)~=prefix then return end
    local action=id:sub(#prefix+1)
    local pool=dicePool(color)
    if action=="close" then clearDiceSelection(pool);STA2E.diceOpen[color]=false;hud();return end
    if action=="clear" then
        clearDiceSelection(pool)
        for _,guid in ipairs(pool.order) do
            local object=obj(guid)
            if object then object.setLock(false) end
            DiceManager.byGuid[guid]=nil
            DiceManager.watching[guid]=nil
        end
        STA2E.dice[color]={dice={},order={},rolling={},revision=0,finalized=false};hud();return
    end
    if pool.finalized then tell(color,"This dice pool is finalized. Clear it to begin another roll.");return end
    if DiceManager.pending(pool) then tell(color,"Wait for every die to settle before changing or finalizing this pool.");return end
    local guid=action:match("^toggle_(.+)$")
    if guid and pool.dice[guid] then setDieSelected(pool.dice[guid],not pool.dice[guid].selected);hud();return end
    if action=="reroll" then rerollDice(color,selectedDice(pool));hud();return end
    if action=="reroll_blanks" then rerollDice(color,selectedDice(pool,function(die)return die.result=="Blank" end));hud();return end
    if action=="spend_bs" then
        local eligible={};for _,die in ipairs(selectedDice(pool)) do if die.result=="Battle Stations" then table.insert(eligible,die) end end
        if #eligible==0 then tell(color,"Select at least one Battle Stations result.");return end
        if not consumeShipToken(color,"BS") then tell(color,"No Battle Stations token linked to the active ship is available.");return end
        for _,die in ipairs(eligible) do
            die.result=pool.kind=="defense" and "Evade" or "Hit"
            rotateDieToResult(die,die.result)
            setDieSelected(die,false)
        end
        hud();return
    end
    local face=action:match("^set_(.+)$")
    if face then
        face=face:gsub("_"," "):gsub("(%a)([%w']*)",function(a,b)return string.upper(a)..string.lower(b)end)
        local legal=pool.kind=="defense" and DEFENSE_FACES or ATTACK_FACES
        local allowed=false;for _,candidate in ipairs(legal) do if candidate==face then allowed=true end end
        if not allowed then tell(color,"That face is not legal for this die type.");return end
        for _,die in ipairs(selectedDice(pool)) do
            die.result=face
            rotateDieToResult(die,face)
            setDieSelected(die,false)
        end
        hud();return
    end
    if action=="finalize" then
        pool.finalized=true
        clearDiceSelection(pool)
        broadcastToAll(color.." finalized: "..diceSummary(color),color=="Blue" and {0.25,0.65,1} or {1,0.35,0.35})
        hud();return
    end
end

-- Shared Sensor Echo workflow used by ship actions, Cloak tokens, and cards.
local SENSOR_ECHO_TEMPLATES={
    {id="BANK_2_FORWARD",label="2 Bank — Forward",distance=4.60,bias=0.83,orientation="forward"},
    {id="BANK_1_FORWARD",label="1 Bank — Forward",distance=3.05,bias=0.83,orientation="forward"},
    {id="STRAIGHT_3",label="3 Straight",distance=6.15,bias=0,orientation="forward"},
    {id="STRAIGHT_2",label="2 Straight",distance=4.60,bias=0,orientation="forward"},
    {id="STRAIGHT_1",label="1 Straight",distance=3.05,bias=0,orientation="forward"},
    {id="BANK_2_REVERSE",label="2 Bank — Reverse",distance=4.60,bias=-0.83,orientation="reverse"},
    {id="BANK_1_REVERSE",label="1 Bank — Reverse",distance=3.05,bias=-0.83,orientation="reverse"},
}
local SENSOR_ECHO_CARD_RULES={}
local SensorEchoController={}

local function echoTemplate(id)
    for _,template in ipairs(SENSOR_ECHO_TEMPLATES) do if template.id==id then return template end end
    return nil
end

local function echoAllowed(session,id)
    for _,allowed in ipairs(session.allowed or {}) do if allowed==id then return true end end
    return false
end

local function isEchoObstacle(object)
    return terrainKind(object)~=nil
end

local function echoCandidateLegal(s,candidate,shape)
    for id,other in pairs(STA2E.ships) do
        if id~=s.instanceId then
            local otherBase=member(other,"base")
            if otherBase then
                local p,r=otherBase.getPosition(),otherBase.getRotation()
                if overlaps(candidate,shape,{x=p.x,z=p.z,yaw=r.y},baseShape(otherBase)) then return false,"ship" end
            end
        end
    end
    local ownBase=member(s,"base")
    for _,object in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if object~=ownBase and isEchoObstacle(object) then
            local p,r=object.getPosition(),object.getRotation()
            if overlaps(candidate,shape,{x=p.x,z=p.z,yaw=r.y},baseShape(object)) then return false,terrainKind(object) or "obstacle" end
        end
    end
    return true,nil
end

local function drawEchoCandidates(s,candidates)
    local base=member(s,"base")
    if not base then return end
    local p,r=base.getPosition(),base.getRotation()
    local shape=baseShape(base)
    local scale=base.getScale()
    local sx=math.max(0.01,math.abs(scale and scale.x or 1))
    local sy=math.max(0.01,math.abs(scale and scale.y or 1))
    local sz=math.max(0.01,math.abs(scale and scale.z or 1))
    local lines={}
    for _,candidate in ipairs(candidates or {}) do
        local lx,lz=rotatePoint(candidate.x-p.x,candidate.z-p.z,-r.y)
        local points={}
        for _,corner in ipairs({{-shape.x,-shape.z},{shape.x,-shape.z},{shape.x,shape.z},{-shape.x,shape.z},{-shape.x,-shape.z}}) do
            local cx,cz=rotatePoint(corner[1],corner[2],candidate.yaw-r.y)
            -- Vector lines use the base's scaled local coordinates. Convert the
            -- world-space landing footprint back into that coordinate system so
            -- the preview exactly matches the position committed below.
            table.insert(points,{(lx+cx)/sx,STA2E_Playtest.guideY(base),(lz+cz)/sz})
        end
        table.insert(lines,{points=points,color=candidate.legal and {0.18,0.90,0.42} or {0.52,0.52,0.56},thickness=0.055})
    end
    base.setVectorLines(lines)
end

function SensorEchoController.calculate(session)
    local s=STA2E.ships[session.instanceId]
    local base=s and member(s,"base")
    local template=echoTemplate(session.template)
    if not s or not base or not template or not session.side then return {} end
    local p,r=base.getPosition(),base.getRotation()
    local scale=base.getScale()
    session.source={guid=base.getGUID(),x=p.x,y=p.y,z=p.z,rx=r.x,yaw=r.y,rz=r.z,sx=scale.x,sy=scale.y,sz=scale.z}
    local start={x=p.x,z=p.z,yaw=r.y}
    -- Player-facing left/right is opposite the old local-side assumption.
    local direction=session.side=="Left" and -1 or 1
    local candidates={}
    local shape=baseShape(base)
    -- Reverse-bank templates deliberately carry a negative bias; they may share
    -- an asset with forward banks but never share placement semantics in code.
    local turn=0
    if template.id:match("^BANK_") then
        -- TTS yaw runs opposite the template-facing sign used by the lateral
        -- displacement. Mirror the bank facing so the landing side edge, not
        -- the rear guides, aligns with the template's far end.
        turn=session.side=="Left" and 45 or -45
        if template.orientation=="reverse" then turn=-turn end
    end
    local finalYaw=start.yaw+turn
    local startHeading=math.rad(start.yaw)
    local finalHeading=math.rad(finalYaw)
    local startForward={x=-math.sin(startHeading),z=-math.cos(startHeading)}
    local finalForward={x=-math.sin(finalHeading),z=-math.cos(finalHeading)}
    -- The stored template distance reaches the far template end from the
    -- starting side. Add the destination base's half-width so that end meets
    -- the near edge of the landing base instead of stopping inside its outline.
    local centered=pose(start,{forward=template.bias,side=direction*(template.distance+shape.x),rotate=0},1)
    -- A Forward placement puts the template at the front of the starting side
    -- and attaches its far end at the back of the landing side. Back reverses
    -- that pair. Because a bank changes facing, both attachment offsets must be
    -- applied in their own ship orientations; this also changes the side offset.
    for _,choice in ipairs({{name="Forward",attachment=1},{name="Lateral",attachment=0},{name="Back",attachment=-1}}) do
        local attachment=choice.attachment*shape.z
        local candidate={
            name=choice.name,
            x=centered.x+attachment*(startForward.x+finalForward.x),
            z=centered.z+attachment*(startForward.z+finalForward.z),
            yaw=finalYaw,
            templateOrientation=template.orientation,
        }
        candidate.legal,candidate.blockedBy=echoCandidateLegal(s,candidate,shape)
        table.insert(candidates,candidate)
    end
    return candidates
end

function SensorEchoController.cancel(color,message)
    local session=STA2E.sensorEcho and STA2E.sensorEcho[color]
    if session then
        local s=STA2E.ships[session.instanceId]
        if s then drawShipGuides(s) end
    end
    if STA2E.sensorEcho then STA2E.sensorEcho[color]=nil end
    if message then tell(color,message) end
    hud()
end

function STA2E_StartSensorEcho(params)
    if not params or not params.color then return end
    local s=STA2E.ships[params.instanceId]
    if not s or not member(s,"base") then tell(params.color,"Deploy the ship before using Sensor Echo.");return end
    local allowed=params.allowed or SENSOR_ECHO_CARD_RULES[params.cardId]
    if not allowed then allowed={};for _,template in ipairs(SENSOR_ECHO_TEMPLATES) do table.insert(allowed,template.id) end end
    STA2E.sensorEcho=STA2E.sensorEcho or {}
    STA2E.sensorEcho[params.color]={instanceId=s.instanceId,sourceType=params.sourceType or "ship",cardId=params.cardId,allowed=copy(allowed),stage="side"}
    hud()
end

function STA2E_SensorEchoAction(player,value,id)
    if not player or not player.color or not id then return end
    local color=player.color
    local prefix="echo_"..color.."_"
    if id:sub(1,#prefix)~=prefix then return end
    local action=id:sub(#prefix+1)
    local session=STA2E.sensorEcho and STA2E.sensorEcho[color]
    if not session then return end
    local s=STA2E.ships[session.instanceId]
    if not s then SensorEchoController.cancel(color);return end
    if action=="cancel" then SensorEchoController.cancel(color,"Sensor Echo cancelled.");return end
    local base=member(s,"base")
    if not base then SensorEchoController.cancel(color,"The ship base is missing. Sensor Echo cancelled.");return end
    local side=action:match("^side_(Left)$") or action:match("^side_(Right)$")
    if side then session.side=side;session.stage="template";hud();return end
    local templateId=action:match("^template_(.+)$")
    if templateId then
        if not echoAllowed(session,templateId) then tell(color,"That Sensor Echo source does not permit this template.");return end
        session.template=templateId;session.stage="candidate";session.candidates=SensorEchoController.calculate(session)
        drawEchoCandidates(s,session.candidates)
        local any=false;for _,candidate in ipairs(session.candidates) do if candidate.legal then any=true end end
        if not any then tell(color,"No Legal Sensor Echo Position") end
        hud();return
    end
    local choice=tonumber(action:match("^commit_(%d+)$"))
    local candidate=choice and session.candidates and session.candidates[choice]
    if not candidate then tell(color,"Choose a Sensor Echo landing position first.");return end
    local p,r=base.getPosition(),base.getRotation()
    local scale=base.getScale()
    local source=session.source
    local function changed(a,b,angle)
        if type(a)~="number" or type(b)~="number" then return true end
        local delta=angle and ((a-b+180)%360-180) or (a-b)
        return math.abs(delta)>0.02
    end
    if not source or source.guid~=base.getGUID() or changed(source.x,p.x) or changed(source.y,p.y) or changed(source.z,p.z) or changed(source.rx,r.x,true) or changed(source.yaw,r.y,true) or changed(source.rz,r.z,true) or changed(source.sx,scale.x) or changed(source.sy,scale.y) or changed(source.sz,scale.z) then
        SensorEchoController.cancel(color,"The ship moved or changed after the Sensor Echo preview. Start Sensor Echo again.");return
    end
    if STA2E.pendingMoves and STA2E.pendingMoves[s.instanceId] then tell(color,"Wait for this ship's movement to finish before using Sensor Echo.");return end
    if not echoTemplate(session.template) or not echoAllowed(session,session.template) then
        SensorEchoController.cancel(color,"The Sensor Echo template is no longer available.");return
    end
    -- Recompute against current ship and obstacle positions immediately before
    -- committing. A green preview is only advisory until the actual move.
    session.candidates=SensorEchoController.calculate(session)
    candidate=session.candidates[choice]
    if not candidate or not candidate.legal then
        drawEchoCandidates(s,session.candidates)
        tell(color,"That Sensor Echo landing position is blocked.");hud();return
    end
    s.undo={position={p.x,p.y,p.z},rotation={r.x,r.y,r.z},state=copy(s.state),round=STA2E.game.round}
    base.setPosition({candidate.x,p.y,candidate.z});base.setRotation({r.x,candidate.yaw,r.z});sync(s)
    if session.sourceType=="ship" and s.state.status=="action" then s.state.status="complete" end
    STA2E.sensorEcho[color]=nil
    drawShipGuides(s);refresh(s)
    broadcastToAll(s.name.." completed Sensor Echo: "..candidate.name.." ("..session.side..", "..echoTemplate(session.template).label..").",{0.82,0.90,1})
    hud()
end

function STA2E_StartupYield(kind)
    local thread=STA2E.startupThread
    if STA2E.loading and thread and coroutine.running()==thread then
        local stats=STA2E.startupStats
        if stats and kind then stats[kind]=(stats[kind] or 0)+1 end
        coroutine.yield()
    end

function onLoad(saved)

    STA2E.game.rulesMode="open"

    STA2E.dice={};STA2E.diceOpen={};STA2E.diceSource={};STA2E.sensorEcho={};DiceManager.byGuid={};DiceManager.watching={}
    STA2E.ready=false;STA2E.loading=true;STA2E.reconciling=false
    STA2E.startupThread=nil;STA2E.startupRegistering=false;STA2E.startupFlushing=false
    STA2E.startupRefreshQueue={};STA2E.startupStats={jobs=0,cards=0,rendered=0}

    local started=Time.time
    local jobIndex,cardIndex=1,1
    local stage,worker,settleUntil,roundProcessed="data",nil,nil,false

    local step

    local function waitingForObjects()

        local alliance=STA2E.game and STA2E.game.alliance
        if alliance and alliance.active then
            if alliance.missionObjects and (tonumber(alliance.missionObjects.pending) or 0)>0 then return true end
            for _,record in pairs(alliance.shipRecords or {}) do
                if not record.cancelled and not record.destroyed and ((tonumber(record.pendingObjects) or 0)>0 or (tonumber(record.pendingShields) or 0)>0) then return true end

                -- can resume the remaining chunks without decoding nil JSON.
                while job and not job.json do jobIndex=jobIndex+1;job=startupJobs[jobIndex] end
                if job then
                    local values=JSON.decode(job.json)
                    for key,value in pairs(values) do job.target[job.offset>=0 and (job.offset+key) or key]=value end
                    job.json=nil;jobIndex=jobIndex+1;STA2E.startupStats.jobs=STA2E.startupStats.jobs+1

                if cardIndex<=#cards then
                    -- Static table indexing is cheap; bound it to 16 rows. World
                    -- object calls below are strictly serialized one at a time.
                    local last=math.min(cardIndex+15,#cards)
                    for i=cardIndex,last do
                        local card=cards[i]
                        local asset=card.assetSheet and CATALOG_DATA.assetSheets and CATALOG_DATA.assetSheets[card.assetSheet]

                            card.cardImage=asset.cardImage;card.cardBack=asset.cardBack;card.sheet=card.sheet or {}

                if not worker then
                    STA2E.startupRegistering=true

                    -- identity reconciliation, guides, and mission recovery.
                    worker=coroutine.create(function() DiceManager.restore(state);STA2E_Reconcile() end)

                local id,ship=next(STA2E.startupRefreshQueue)

                    STA2E.startupRefreshQueue[id]=nil
                    if STA2E.ships[id]==ship then
                        STA2E.startupFlushing=true;refresh(ship);STA2E.startupFlushing=false

                    end

                end

                STA2E.loading=false;STA2E.ready=true;STA2E.startupStage="complete"
                startupJobs=nil

            end
        end)

            done=true;STA2E.ready=false;STA2E.loading=true;STA2E.reconciling=false
            STA2E.startupThread=nil;STA2E.startupRegistering=false;STA2E.startupFlushing=false;STA2E.startupRefreshQueue=nil;STA2E.startupStage="failed"
            print("STA2E startup failed: "..tostring(err))

        end
    end
    Wait.frames(step,1)
end

function AllianceAI.resolve(dial,instruction,hand)

  local family=aiFallback[index]

   local prefix,speed=entry.key:match("^([A-Z]+)(%d+)$")

   if family=="T" or family=="B" then
    if not hand then return nil,"Toward/Away is ambiguous: choose Port or Starboard override" end
    matches=prefix==family..hand
   end
   if matches and MOVE_DEFS[entry.key] then table.insert(candidates,{entry=entry,speed=tonumber(speed)}) end
  end

   local preference=index==start and instruction.speed or "fast"

STA2E_MISSION_HULL_SCRIPT = [========[
-- Reusable Alliance objective hull counter. Zero hull keeps the token on the
-- table, with its controls available for correcting damage or repairing an undo.
local hullMemory={hull=8,maxHull=8,kind="objective",missionId="",runId="",label="Objective"}

local function hullClamp(value,maximum)
    return math.max(0,math.min(maximum,math.floor(tonumber(value) or maximum)))
end

function getHull()
    return {guid=self.getGUID(),hull=hullMemory.hull,maxHull=hullMemory.maxHull,
        kind=hullMemory.kind,missionId=hullMemory.missionId,runId=hullMemory.runId,
        label=hullMemory.label,index=hullMemory.index,destroyed=hullMemory.hull==0}
end

local function hullDraw()
    self.clearButtons()
    local dead=hullMemory.hull==0
    self.setColorTint(dead and {0.38,0.38,0.38} or {1,1,1})
    self.setDescription((hullMemory.rules or "").."\nHull: "..hullMemory.hull.." / "..hullMemory.maxHull..
        (dead and "\nDESTROYED. Token retained; + can correct damage." or "\nUse - for damage and + to correct or restore hull."))
    self.createButton({function_owner=self,click_function="hullNoop",
        label=(dead and "DESTROYED\n" or "HULL\n")..hullMemory.hull.." / "..hullMemory.maxHull,
        position={0,0.23,0},rotation={0,0,0},width=0,height=0,font_size=175,
        font_color=dead and {1,0.35,0.25} or {1,1,1},tooltip="Current hull / maximum hull"})
    self.createButton({function_owner=self,click_function="hullMinus",label="-",
        position={-0.72,0.24,0.72},rotation={0,0,0},width=400,height=340,font_size=260,
        color={0.56,0.14,0.10,0.96},font_color={1,1,1},tooltip="Remove 1 hull (minimum 0)"})
    self.createButton({function_owner=self,click_function="hullPlus",label="+",
        position={0.72,0.24,0.72},rotation={0,0,0},width=400,height=340,font_size=260,
        color={0.10,0.40,0.22,0.96},font_color={1,1,1},tooltip="Restore 1 hull (maximum "..hullMemory.maxHull..")"})
end

function hullNoop() end

function setHull(params)
    local request=type(params)=="table" and params or {hull=params}
    local previous=hullMemory.hull
    if request.maxHull then hullMemory.maxHull=math.max(1,math.floor(tonumber(request.maxHull) or hullMemory.maxHull)) end
    hullMemory.hull=hullClamp(request.hull,hullMemory.maxHull)
    hullDraw()
    local event=getHull()
    if not request.silent and hullMemory.hull~=previous then
        -- Global validates both runId and missionId, so an old token cannot
        -- alter the results of a later mission after a reset or reload.
        pcall(function() Global.call("STA2E_MissionHullChanged",event) end)
    end
    return event
end

function hullMinus() return setHull({hull=hullMemory.hull-1}) end
function hullPlus() return setHull({hull=hullMemory.hull+1}) end

function onLoad(saved)
    if saved and saved~="" then
        local ok,decoded=pcall(JSON.decode,saved)
        if ok and type(decoded)=="table" then
            for key,value in pairs(decoded) do hullMemory[key]=value end
        end
    end
    hullMemory.maxHull=math.max(1,math.floor(tonumber(hullMemory.maxHull) or 8))
    hullMemory.hull=hullClamp(hullMemory.hull,hullMemory.maxHull)
    self.setLock(true)
    hullDraw()
end

function onSave() return JSON.encode(hullMemory) end

]========]

    local function boardFrame()
        local board=getObjectFromGUID("ae9c49")

        local rotation=board and board.getRotation() or {y=90}
        local scale=board and board.getScale() or {x=1.89,z=1.89}
        return {x=position.x or position[1],y=(position.y or position[2])+0.50,z=position.z or position[3],
            yaw=(rotation.y or rotation[2] or 90)-90,
            halfX=18.1*(scale.x or scale[1] or 1.89)/1.89,
            halfZ=18.1*(scale.z or scale[3] or 1.89)/1.89}
    end

    local function point(frame,u,v,height)
        local angle=math.rad(frame.yaw)
        local x,z=u*frame.halfX,v*frame.halfZ
        return {x=frame.x+x*math.cos(angle)+z*math.sin(angle),
            y=frame.y+(height or 0),z=frame.z-x*math.sin(angle)+z*math.cos(angle)}
    end

    local function makeAnchors(definition,frame)
        local kind=kindOf(definition)
        local source=bearingLayouts[kind] or bearingLayouts.standard
        local result={}
        for index,item in ipairs(source) do
            local u,v=item[1],item[2]
            -- Ship centers are inset from the edge by a base half-width.
            if item[3]=="left" then u=u+1.55/frame.halfX
            elseif item[3]=="right" then u=u-1.55/frame.halfX
            elseif item[3]=="top" then v=v-1.55/frame.halfZ
            else v=v+1.55/frame.halfZ end
            result[index]={position=point(frame,u,v,0.3),rotation=(item[4]+frame.yaw)%360,
                edge=item[3],bearing=index,u=item[1],v=item[2]}
        end
        return result
    end

    function M.anchors(subject)

        if guide then drawGuide(guide,registry) end
