    local function registerObject(state,registry,spec,object,ready)
        local guid=object.getGUID()
        object.setGMNotes(ownership(registry,spec.metadata.kind,spec.metadata))
        local row=clone(spec.metadata);row.guid=guid;row.missionId=registry.missionId;row.runId=registry.runId
        registry.registered=registry.registered or {}
        if not registry.registered[guid] then
            registry.registered[guid]=true
            registry.guids[#registry.guids+1]=guid;registry.objects[#registry.objects+1]=row
        end
        state.generatedGUIDs=state.generatedGUIDs or {};state.generatedGUIDs[guid]=true
        if row.maxHull or row.kind=="listeningPost" or row.kind=="weaponPlatform" then registry.hullObjects[guid]=row end
        if row.kind=="guide" then
            registry.guideGUID=guid
            if ready then drawGuide(object,registry) end
        end
        if spec.metadata.planIndex then
            registry.planGUIDs=registry.planGUIDs or {};registry.readyPlans=registry.readyPlans or {}
            local key=tostring(spec.metadata.planIndex)
            registry.planGUIDs[key]=guid
            if ready then registry.readyPlans[key]=true end
            M.attachScenarioModels(state,registry)
        end
        return guid
    end

    local function submitPlan(state,registry,spec,key)
        spec.data.GMNotes=ownership(registry,spec.metadata.kind,spec.metadata)
        local callbackDone=false
        local ok,result=pcall(function()
            return spawnObjectData({data=spec.data,position=spec.position,rotation=spec.rotation,
                sound=false,callback_function=function(object)
                    if callbackDone then return end
                    callbackDone=true
                    registry.pending=math.max(0,registry.pending-1)
                    if not object then registry.errors[#registry.errors+1]="A "..spec.metadata.kind.." did not spawn."
                    elseif not currentRun(state,registry) then
                        registry.pendingPlans[key]=nil;pcall(function() object.destruct() end)
                    else
                        local registered,message=pcall(registerObject,state,registry,spec,object,true)
                        if registered then registry.pendingPlans[key]=nil
                        else registry.errors[#registry.errors+1]=tostring(message) end
                    end
                    if registry.pending==0 and #registry.errors==0 and currentRun(state,registry) then registry.setupComplete=true end
                end})
        end)
        if not ok then
            if not callbackDone then registry.pending=math.max(0,registry.pending-1) end
            registry.errors[#registry.errors+1]=tostring(result)
        elseif result and not callbackDone and currentRun(state,registry) then
            -- TTS returns the spawning object before its callback. Register its
            -- GUID now so reset/save can own it during that interval as well.
            local registered,guid=pcall(registerObject,state,registry,spec,result,false)
            if registered then spec.guid=guid end
        end
    end

function M.addScenarioModel(plans,registry,baseIndex,kind,title,position,rotation)
    local data=asset(kind.."Model",title.." Model")
    local offset=(assets[kind.."Model"] or {}).scenarioOffset or (kind=="miranda" and 0.2126 or 0.2)
    data.scenarioOffset=nil

    local childIndex=#plans+1
    addPlan(plans,data,childPosition,rotation,{kind="scenarioModel",parentPlanIndex=baseIndex,shipKind=kind})
    registry.attachmentPairs=registry.attachmentPairs or {}
    registry.attachmentPairs[tostring(childIndex)]={basePlanIndex=baseIndex,modelPlanIndex=childIndex,shipKind=kind,offset=offset}

function M.attachScenarioModels(state,registry)
    if not currentRun(state,registry) then return end
    for _,pair in pairs(registry.attachmentPairs or {}) do
        if not pair.attached then
            local baseKey,modelKey=tostring(pair.basePlanIndex),tostring(pair.modelPlanIndex)
            local baseGUID=(registry.planGUIDs or {})[baseKey]
            local modelGUID=(registry.planGUIDs or {})[modelKey]
            local base=baseGUID and getObjectFromGUID(baseGUID)
            local model=modelGUID and getObjectFromGUID(modelGUID)
            if base and model and (registry.readyPlans or {})[baseKey] and (registry.readyPlans or {})[modelKey] then
                local ok,err=pcall(function()
                    -- The base may have been moved while assets were loading.
                    local p=base.getPosition()
                    model.setPosition({x=p.x,y=p.y+pair.offset,z=p.z})
                    model.setRotation(base.getRotation())
                    model.setLock(false)
                    base.addAttachment(model)
                end)
                if ok then
                    pair.attached=true;pair.baseGUID=baseGUID
                    -- The model is now a native attachment, not a loose object.
                    state.generatedGUIDs[modelGUID]=nil
                else registry.errors[#registry.errors+1]="Could not attach "..pair.shipKind.." model: "..tostring(err) end
            end
        end
    end
end

        local angle=math.rad(frame.yaw);local x,z=site.u*frame.halfX,site.v*frame.halfZ
        local location={x=frame.x+x*math.cos(angle)+z*math.sin(angle),z=frame.z-x*math.sin(angle)+z*math.cos(angle)}
        local choices,best={},nil
        for i,a in ipairs(s.missionObjects.anchors) do
            local d=(a.position.x-location.x)^2+(a.position.z-location.z)^2
            if not best or d>best+0.0001 then best=d;choices={i} elseif math.abs(d-best)<0.0001 then choices[#choices+1]=i end
        end
        local bearing=choices[math.random(1,#choices)]
        state.facilityIndex=index;state.facilityRound=STA2E.game.round;state.facilityBearing=bearing
        for _,row in ipairs(s.definition.formations) do if row.event=='facility' then
            row.round=STA2E.game.round+1;row.bearing=bearing;s.waves[row.id].round=row.round;s.waves[row.id].status='scheduled after reveal'
        end end

        R.say('Facility on asteroid '..index..'. Dominion Alpha arrives next round at furthest bearing '..bearing..'. While intact, Jem\'Hadar convert one blank attack result to a hit (manual).')
    elseif action=='defect' and s.missionId=='A9M1' then
        if STA2E.game.round<(state.supplyRun and 4 or 5) then return {ok=false,error='Cardassian defection is not due yet.'} end
        R.book3Defect(s)
    elseif (action=='bombardment' or action=='populationPlus' or action=='populationMinus') and s.missionId=='A9M2' then
        local population=state.population
        if action=='bombardment' then
            local round=tonumber(STA2E.game.round) or 0
            if round<1 or STA2E.game.phase~='planning' then return {ok=false,error='Bombardment is resolved at the start of the round (Planning).'} end
            if state.lastBombardmentRound>=round then return {ok=false,error='Bombardment already rolled this round. Use population +/- to correct manual results.'} end
            local platforms=0
            for _,row in ipairs(R.hulls(s)) do if row.kind=='weaponPlatform' and (tonumber(row.hull) or 0)>0 then platforms=platforms+1 end end
            local loss,results=0,{}
            for i=1,platforms+1 do
                local die=math.random(1,8);local result=die<=3 and 'hit' or die==4 and 'critical' or die<=6 and 'BS' or 'blank'
                results[#results+1]=result;if result=='hit' or result=='critical' then loss=loss+1 end
            end
            population=math.max(0,population-loss);state.lastBombardmentRound=round
            state.lastBombardment={round=round,dice=platforms+1,results=results,loss=loss}
            R.say('Bombardment Round '..round..': '..table.concat(results,', ')..'; '..loss..' population lost; '..population..' remain.')
        else population=math.max(0,math.min(50,population+(action=='populationPlus' and 1 or -1))) end
        state.population=population;STA2E.MissionObjects.book3Population(s,population)
        if population==0 then R.say('Cardassian population is zero: campaign failure. Resolve with FINISH.',{1,0.35,0.25}) end
    else return {ok=false,error='This event is not available in this mission.'} end
    return STA2E_MissionStatus({id=s.missionId})
end

-- Guard the legacy asynchronous card/component callbacks with session identity.
-- Unrelated fleet spawns pass straight through this adapter.
function spawnObjectData(params)
    local s=R.current();local m
    if s and params and params.data and params.data.LuaScriptState then
        local ok,value=pcall(JSON.decode,params.data.LuaScriptState)
        if ok and type(value)=="table" then m=value end
    end
    local id=m and (m.instanceId or (m.transaction and m.transaction:match("^alliance:(.+)$")))
    local context=R.context
    if not s or not id or not ((s.shipRecords or {})[id] or (context and context.state==s)) then return previousSpawn(params) end
    local record=R.record(s,id)
    if context and context.slot then context.slot.instanceId=id end
    record.pendingObjects=(record.pendingObjects or 0)+1
    local callback=params.callback_function
    local wrapped={};for key,value in pairs(params) do wrapped[key]=value end
    wrapped.callback_function=function(object)
        record.pendingObjects=math.max(0,(record.pendingObjects or 1)-1)
        if not R.valid(s) or record.cancelled then R.destroy(object);return end
        R.remember(s,object)
        local ok,err=true,nil
        if callback then ok,err=pcall(callback,object) end
        if not ok then record.error=tostring(err);R.say("Component callback failed: "..record.error,{1,0.45,0.2}) end
        if m.role=="pending" and object then
            record.cardCreated=true;record.cardGUID=object.getGUID();record.pendingCardGUID=nil
            local slot=R.findSlot(s,id);if slot then slot.cardCreated=true end
            R.applyOrders(s,id)
        end
        R.refreshWaves(s)
    end
    local ok,result=pcall(previousSpawn,wrapped)
    if not ok then record.pendingObjects=math.max(0,record.pendingObjects-1);record.error=tostring(result);error(result) end
    if result and result.getGUID then
        R.remember(s,result)
        if m.role=="pending" and not record.cardCreated then record.pendingCardGUID=result.getGUID() end
    end
    return result
end

function R.shieldCount(s,record)

end
function R.shields(s,ship)
    local record=R.record(s,ship.instanceId)
    if record.shieldsComplete then return end
    local card=obj(ship.cardGUID);local bag=obj(ACTION_BAGS.SHIELD)
    if not card or not bag then record.shieldError="Shield supply or ship card is unavailable.";return end
    local target=tonumber(ship.missionShieldCount) or 2
    local existing=R.shieldCount(s,record)
    if existing>=target then record.shieldsComplete=true;record.shieldError=nil;return end
    local missing=math.max(0,target-existing-(record.pendingShields or 0))
    local p=card.getPosition()
    for index=1,missing do
        local lane=existing+(record.pendingShields or 0)
        record.pendingShields=(record.pendingShields or 0)+1
        local ok,err=pcall(function()
            local pendingToken=bag.takeObject({position={p.x-1.2+lane*0.55,p.y+0.6,p.z+2.15},callback_function=function(token)
                record.pendingShields=math.max(0,(record.pendingShields or 1)-1)
                if not R.valid(s) or record.cancelled then R.destroy(token);return end
                if token then
                    token.setGMNotes("STA2E_ALLIANCE_SHIELD|"..ship.instanceId)
                    record.shieldGUIDs[token.getGUID()]=true;R.remember(s,token)
                end
                if R.shieldCount(s,record)>=target then record.shieldsComplete=true;record.shieldError=nil end
                R.refreshWaves(s)
            end})
            if pendingToken and pendingToken.getGUID then R.remember(s,pendingToken) end
        end)
        if not ok then record.pendingShields=math.max(0,record.pendingShields-1);record.shieldError=tostring(err) end
    end
end
allianceSpawnShields=function(ship,count)
    local s=R.current()
    if s and (s.shipRecords or {})[ship.instanceId] then return R.shields(s,ship) end
    return previousShields(ship,count)
end

function R.ready(s,slot)

    local ship=STA2E.ships[slot.instanceId]
    return ship and complete(ship) and not STA2E.pending[slot.instanceId] and (record.pendingObjects or 0)==0
        and (record.pendingShields or 0)==0 and record.shieldsComplete==true

                R.say("Escape route open at the "..tostring(wave.edge).." edge (Beta bearing "..tostring(wave.bearing)..").")
            end

end
function R.reservationBlocked(s,position,exclude,ignoreWave)
    for _,wave in pairs(s.waves or {}) do

            local record=slot.instanceId and (s.shipRecords or {})[slot.instanceId]
            local reserved=wave.requested and (not record or (not record.cancelled and not record.destroyed and not R.ready(s,slot)))
            if wave~=ignoreWave and slot~=exclude and slot.placement and reserved then
                local p=slot.placement.position
                if (p.x-position.x)^2+(p.z-position.z)^2<10.25 then return true end
            end

end
function R.placementClear(s,wave,placement,exclude)
    local own={};for _,slot in ipairs(wave.slots or {}) do if slot.instanceId then own[slot.instanceId]=slot.placement.position end end
    local p=placement.position
    for id,ship in pairs(STA2E.ships) do
        local base=member(ship,"base")
        if base then
            local q=base.getPosition();local original=own[id]
            local inOriginalLane=original and (q.x-original.x)^2+(q.z-original.z)^2<0.04
            if not inOriginalLane and (q.x-p.x)^2+(q.z-p.z)^2<10.25 then return false end
        end
    end
    for _,object in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        local name=string.lower((object.getName and object.getName()) or "")
        if name:find("planet",1,true) or name:find("asteroid",1,true) or name:find("obstacle",1,true) then
            local q=object.getPosition();if (q.x-p.x)^2+(q.z-p.z)^2<12.25 then return false end
        end
    end
    return not R.reservationBlocked(s,p,exclude,wave)
end
function R.chooseFormation(s,row,wave,count)
    if row.sites then
        local placements=STA2E.MissionObjects.book2Placements(s,row.sites)
        if #placements~=count then return nil,nil,"Printed fixed formation count does not match this player count." end
        for _,placement in ipairs(placements) do
            if not R.placementClear(s,wave,placement) then return nil,nil,"Printed setup position blocked; clear it and Retry." end
        end
        return placements,0,nil,"printed setup"
    end
    local anchors=STA2E.MissionObjects and STA2E.MissionObjects.anchors and STA2E.MissionObjects.anchors(s)
    if type(anchors)~="table" then return nil,nil,"Mission deployment anchors are unavailable." end
    local choices={}
    if row.bearing then choices[1]=tonumber(row.bearing)
    else local start=math.random(1,6);for offset=0,5 do table.insert(choices,((start+offset-1)%6)+1) end end
    for _,bearing in ipairs(choices) do
        local anchor=anchors[bearing] or anchors[R.numberKey(bearing)]
        local distinct=row.distinctBearing or (s.definition.distinctBearing and row.round==1)
        local excluded=false;for _,n in ipairs(row.excludedBearings or {}) do if n==bearing then excluded=true end end
        if anchor and not excluded and not (distinct and (s.usedInitialBearings or {})[R.numberKey(bearing)]) then
            local placements=allianceFormation(anchor,count)
            if placements then
                local clear=true;for _,placement in ipairs(placements) do if R.reservationBlocked(s,placement.position) then clear=false end end
                if clear then return placements,bearing,nil,anchor.edge end
            end
        end
    end
    return nil,nil,"No legal "..(row.bearing and ("fixed bearing "..row.bearing) or "mission bearing").." is clear; move blocking pieces and press Retry."
end
function R.spawnWave(s,row)
    local wave=s.waves[row.id]
    if wave.cancelled then return true end
    if wave.spawned then return true end
    local count=R.count(row,s.playerCount)
    if count==0 then wave.requested=true;wave.spawned=true;wave.status="not required";return true end
    if not wave.placements then
        local placements,bearing,err,edge=R.chooseFormation(s,row,wave,count)
        if not placements then wave.status="blocked";wave.error=err;return false end
        wave.placements=placements;wave.bearing=bearing;wave.edge=edge
        if row.distinctBearing or (s.definition.distinctBearing and row.round==1) then s.usedInitialBearings[R.numberKey(bearing)]=true end
        for index=1,count do wave.slots[index]={placement=placements[index],profile=(row.slotProfiles or {})[index] or row.profile or "generic"} end
    end
    wave.requested=true;wave.status="pending"
    for _,slot in ipairs(wave.slots) do
        if not slot.instanceId then
            if not R.placementClear(s,wave,slot.placement,slot) then
                wave.status="blocked";wave.error="Reserved deployment position is blocked; move blocking pieces and press Retry.";return false
            end
            R.context={state=s,slot=slot}
            local ok,id=pcall(allianceSpawnShip,{profile=slot.profile or row.profile or "generic"},slot.placement)
            R.context=nil
            if not ok or not id then wave.status="blocked";wave.error="Enemy spawn failed: "..tostring(id or "profile/card unavailable");return false end
            slot.instanceId=id
            local record=R.record(s,id);record.formationId=row.id
            Wait.time(function()
                if R.valid(s) and slot.instanceId==id and not record.cardCreated then
                    record.cancelled=true;slot.instanceId=nil;wave.status="blocked";wave.error="Enemy card spawn timed out; press Retry."
                end
            end,20)
        elseif slot.cardCreated then
            local ship=STA2E.ships[slot.instanceId];local record=s.shipRecords[slot.instanceId]
            if ship and not record.destroyed then
                if not complete(ship) and not STA2E.pending[ship.instanceId] then deploy(ship) end
                R.shields(s,ship)
            end
        end
    end
    if not wave.announced then
        wave.announced=true
        R.say(row.name..": "..count.." ship(s), bearing "..tostring(wave.bearing)..", "..row.orders.." orders.")
        if row.orders~="Attack" then R.say(row.orders.." orders require manual mission target selection and maneuver control; the generic Attack AI is disabled for this formation.",{1,0.78,0.35}) end
    end
    R.refreshWaves(s);return true
end
function R.process(s)
    if not R.valid(s) then return end
    s.round=tonumber(STA2E.game.round) or 0
    if s.definition.book3 then R.book3Round(s) end
    for _,row in ipairs(s.definition.formations or {}) do
        if (tonumber(row.round) or 0)<=s.round then R.spawnWave(s,row) end
    end
    R.refreshWaves(s)
end
function STA2E_AllianceProcessRound()
    local s=R.current()
    if not s then return previousProcess() end
    if STA2E.game.phase=="planning" then R.process(s) end
end

function R.pending(s)
    if s.missionObjects and s.missionObjects.setupComplete==false and #(s.missionObjects.errors or {})==0 then return true end
    for _,record in pairs(s.shipRecords or {}) do
        if not record.cancelled and not record.destroyed and ((not record.cardCreated) or (record.pendingObjects or 0)>0 or (record.pendingShields or 0)>0 or STA2E.pending[record.instanceId]) then return true end
    end
    return false
end
function R.blocked(s)
    if s.missionObjects and #(s.missionObjects.errors or {})>0 then return "Mission object setup failed: "..tostring(s.missionObjects.errors[1]) end
    for _,row in ipairs(s.definition.formations or {}) do
        local wave=s.waves[row.id]
        if (tonumber(row.round) or 0)<=(tonumber(STA2E.game.round) or 0) and not wave.spawned then return wave.error or "Mission deployment is incomplete; press Retry after clearing deployment points." end
    end

function R.hulls(s)
    if STA2E.MissionObjects and STA2E.MissionObjects.hulls then return STA2E.MissionObjects.hulls(s) or {} end
    return {}
end
function R.listeningScore(s)
    local rows=R.hulls(s);local alive,healthy=0,0
    -- User adaptation: +1 for at least one surviving post, +1 per post above 5 hull.
    for _,row in ipairs(rows) do local hull=tonumber(row.hull) or 0;if hull>=1 then alive=alive+1 end;if hull>5 then healthy=healthy+1 end end
    return {round=STA2E.game.round,success=alive>=1,objectiveXP=(alive>=1 and 1 or 0)+healthy,hulls=copy(rows)}
end
function R.enemies(s)
    local live=0
    for id,record in pairs(s.shipRecords or {}) do
        local ship=STA2E.ships[id]
        if record.cardCreated and not record.destroyed and ship and not (ship.combat and ship.combat.destroyed) and obj(ship.cardGUID) then live=live+1 end
    end
    return live
end
function R.finish(s,params)
    if R.pending(s) then return {ok=false,error="Wait for mission spawning to finish before resolving it."} end
    params=params or {}
    local earlyClear=false
    if s.missionId=="A2M4" and not s.round10Score and not params.outcome then
        earlyClear=R.enemies(s)==0
        for _,wave in pairs(s.waves or {}) do if not wave.spawned then earlyClear=false end end
        if not earlyClear then return {ok=false,error="Listening Posts resolves at its Round 10 objective checkpoint and Round 12 deadline, or when every scheduled Dominion wave has deployed and been destroyed."} end
    end
    local score=params.score or (s.missionId=="A2M4" and (s.round10Score or R.listeningScore(s)))
    s.active=false;s.finished=true;s.finishedRound=STA2E.game.round
    s.result={outcome=params.outcome or (earlyClear and "success") or (score and (score.success and "success" or "failure")) or "manual",
        objectiveXP=tonumber(params.objectiveXP) or (score and score.objectiveXP),score=score,notes=params.notes or "Resolve player-specific XP and destroyed-player penalties manually."}
    R.say(s.definition.name.." finished: "..s.result.outcome..(s.result.objectiveXP and ("; objective XP "..s.result.objectiveXP.." per player before penalties.") or "; record objective outcome and XP manually."))
    hud();return STA2E_MissionStatus({id=s.missionId})
end
function R.checkEarly(s)
    if not R.valid(s) or s.missionId~="A2M4" or R.pending(s) then return end
    for _,wave in pairs(s.waves) do if not wave.spawned then return end end
    if #R.hulls(s)<2 then return end
    if R.enemies(s)==0 then R.finish(s,{outcome="success",score=s.round10Score or R.listeningScore(s),notes="All required formations deployed and all Dominion ships destroyed."}) end
end
function R.endRound(s,round)
    if not R.valid(s) then return end
    if s.missionId=="A2M4" and round>=10 and not s.round10Score then
        s.round10Score=R.listeningScore(s);s.round10Score.round=10
        R.say("Round 10 listening-post objective recorded: "..(s.round10Score.success and "success" or "failure")..", "..s.round10Score.objectiveXP.." objective XP. Continue through Round 12 unless all Dominion formations are cleared.")
    end
    if s.definition.book3 and not s.definition.maxRound then return end
    if round>=(tonumber(s.definition.maxRound) or 10) then
        s.deadlineReached=true
        if s.missionId=="A2M4" then R.finish(s,{score=s.round10Score or R.listeningScore(s),notes="End of Round 12; remaining Dominion ships retreat. Round 10 objective and XP checkpoint retained."})
        elseif not s.deadlineAnnounced then s.deadlineAnnounced=true;R.say("Mission deadline reached. Resolve the printed retreat/destruction rules, then use Finish to record the mission result.",{1,0.78,0.35}) end
    end
end
function STA2E_PhaseUI(player,value)
    local s=R.current();local reverse=tostring(value)=="-2"
    if R.valid(s) and not reverse then
        if R.pending(s) then tell(player and player.color or "Black","Wait for mission spawning to finish.");return end
        local blocked=R.blocked(s);if blocked then tell(player and player.color or "Black",blocked);return end
        if s.deadlineReached then tell(player and player.color or "Black","Resolve this mission with Finish or Reset before advancing beyond its deadline.");return end
    end
    local beforeRound,beforePhase=STA2E.game.round,STA2E.game.phase
    previousPhase(player,value)
    if R.valid(s) and not reverse and beforePhase=="end" and (STA2E.game.round~=beforeRound or STA2E.game.phase~=beforePhase) then
        R.endRound(s,beforeRound)
        if s.deadlineReached then STA2E.game.round=beforeRound;STA2E.game.phase="end";hud() end
    end

end

function R.cleanup(s)
    s.resetting=true;s.active=false
    if STA2E.game.alliance==s then STA2E.game.alliance=nil end
    if STA2E.MissionObjects and STA2E.MissionObjects.teardown then STA2E.MissionObjects.teardown(s) end
    local owned={};for id in pairs(s.shipRecords or {}) do owned[id]=true end
    for _,object in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        local guid=object.getGUID();local m=metadata(object);local notes=object.getGMNotes and object.getGMNotes() or ""
        local shieldId=notes:match("^STA2E_ALLIANCE_SHIELD|(.+)$")
        if (s.generatedGUIDs or {})[guid] or (m and owned[m.instanceId]) or (shieldId and owned[shieldId]) then object.destruct() end
    end
    for id in pairs(owned) do STA2E.ships[id]=nil;STA2E.pending[id]=nil;if STA2E.pendingMoves then STA2E.pendingMoves[id]=nil end end
end
function STA2E_MissionStart(params)
    params=params or {}
    if not STA2E.ready then return {ok=false,error="Fleet systems are still loading."} end
    if allianceState() and allianceState().active then return {ok=false,error="Another Alliance mission is active. Finish or Reset it first."} end
    if next(STA2E.pending or {}) or next(STA2E.imports or {}) or next(STA2E.pendingMoves or {}) then return {ok=false,error="Wait for fleet spawning or movement to finish."} end

function STA2E_Book3Prepare(d,params,players)
    local options=params.priorResults or {}
    for _,key in ipairs({'penumbra','supplyRun'}) do
        if options[key]~=nil and type(options[key])~='boolean' then return nil,key..' must be Success or Failure.' end
    end
    local finish=tonumber(options.dogsRound or 7)
    if not finish or finish~=math.floor(finish) or finish<1 or finish>9 then return nil,'Dogs of War completion round must be 1-9.' end
    local factions={};local allowed={federation=true,klingon=true,romulan=true}
    for i=1,players do
        factions[i]=(params.escortFactions or {})[i] or 'romulan'
        if not allowed[factions[i]] then return nil,'Choose Federation, Klingon or Romulan escort.' end
    end
    d.book3Settings={penumbra=options.penumbra==true,supplyRun=options.supplyRun==true,dogsRound=finish,escortFactions=factions}
    if d.id=='A7M1' then d.profiles.BSR.shields=2*players;d.profiles.BSE.shields=2*players end
    if d.id=='A9M2' then
        d.book3Settings.population=3*players+(d.book3Settings.supplyRun and 2 or 0)-(finish==9 and 2 or finish==8 and 1 or 0)
    end
    return d
end

;(function()
    local A={}
    STA2E.AllianceCaptain=A
    function A.pendingState(data,color,transaction)
        local state=decode(data.LuaScriptState) or {version=2}
        state.memory={schemaVersion=1,role="pending",transaction=transaction}
        local player=Player[color]
        state.name=player and player.steam_name and player.steam_name~="" and player.steam_name or "Alliance Captain"
        data.Nickname=state.name
        return JSON.encode(state)
    end
    function A.apply(s,entry,snapshot)
        if type(snapshot)~="table" then return false end
        local name=tostring(snapshot.name or "")
        local skill=tonumber(snapshot.skill)
        if not skill or skill~=skill then return false end
        skill=math.max(2,math.min(9,math.floor(skill)))
        local xp=math.max(0,math.floor(tonumber(snapshot.xp) or 0))
        local old=s.allianceCaptain
        if old and old.guid==entry.guid and old.name==name and old.skill==skill and old.xp==xp then return false end
        if old and old.guid==entry.guid and old.skill~=skill then s.skillOverride=nil end
        s.allianceCaptain={guid=entry.guid,cardId=entry.cardId,name=name,skill=skill,xp=xp}
        return true
    end
    function A.syncCaptain(s)
        for _,entry in ipairs(s.upgrades or {}) do
            local card=CATALOG[entry.cardId]
            if card and card.type=="captain" then
                if not card.interactiveCaptain then return false end
                local object=obj(entry.guid)
                if not object then return false end
                local ok,snapshot=pcall(function() return object.call("STA2E_CaptainSnapshot") end)
                return ok and A.apply(s,entry,snapshot) or false
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    function A.syncShipName(s)
        local card=obj(s.cardGUID)
        if not card then return false end
        local actual=tostring(card.getName() or "")
        if s.observedShipCardName==nil then s.observedShipCardName=actual;return false end
        if actual==s.observedShipCardName then return false end
        s.observedShipCardName=actual
        local cleaned=actual:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        local name=cleaned~="" and cleaned or importedShipName(CATALOG[s.definitionId])
        if name==s.name then return false end
        s.name=name
        return true
    end
    function A.scan()
        for _,s in pairs(STA2E.ships or {}) do
            local shipChanged=A.syncShipName(s)
            local captainChanged=A.syncCaptain(s)
            if shipChanged or captainChanged then refresh(s) end
        end
    end
    function STA2E_AllianceCaptainChanged(params)
        local object=params and params.object
        local m=metadata(object)
        local s=m and STA2E.ships[m.instanceId]
        if not s or m.role~="upgrade" or m.cardGUID~=s.cardGUID then return end
        for _,entry in ipairs(s.upgrades or {}) do
            local card=CATALOG[entry.cardId]
            if entry.guid==object.getGUID() and card and card.interactiveCaptain then
                if A.apply(s,entry,params.snapshot) then refresh(s) end
                return
            end
        end
    end
    local previousUpdate=onUpdate
    local nextCheck=0
    function onUpdate()
        if previousUpdate then previousUpdate() end
        if not STA2E.ready or STA2E.loading or STA2E.reconciling or Time.time<nextCheck then return end
        nextCheck=Time.time+0.5
        A.scan()
    end
    local previousReconcile=STA2E_Reconcile
    function STA2E_Reconcile()
        previousReconcile()
        A.scan()
    end
    local previousSave=onSave
    function onSave()
        if STA2E.ready and not STA2E.loading then A.scan() end
        return previousSave()
    end
end)()

ObjectStates.Description:
When decks are made, their cards all have the same GUID. This can cause issues with scripts that try to pull cards by GUID, for example.

This solves the issue by spawning all cards are once so they get new GUIDs assigned, then they all fall back together. Save the newly formed deck and you're set.
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
-- Deal once per card, including the final deck remainder, then regroup by gravity.
local activeJob = nil
function onLoad() createActivationButton() end
function click_fixDeck()
    if activeJob then return end
    local decks=findInRadiusBy(self.getPosition(),2,function(o) return o.tag=="Deck" end)
    if #decks==0 then broadcastToAll("ERROR: No deck found on device.",{0.9,0.2,0.2}); return end
    self.clearButtons()
    spawnAllCards(decks[1])
end
local function capture(job,card)
    if not card then return end
    if not job.seen[card] then job.seen[card]=true; job.cards[#job.cards+1]=card end
    -- Late spawn callbacks must release cards after cleanup, never relock them.
    pcall(function() card.setLock(job.active) end)
end
local function cleanup(job)
    job.active=false
    for i=#job.cards,1,-1 do pcall(function() job.cards[i].setLock(false) end) end
    pcall(function() job.deck.setLock(false) end)
    activeJob=nil
    createActivationButton()
end
function spawnAllCards(deck)
    if activeJob then return end
    local job={deck=deck,cards={},seen={},active=true}
    activeJob=job
    function spawnAllCards_routine()
        local ready,problem=pcall(function()
            deck.setLock(true)
            job.position=deck.getPosition()
            job.count=#deck.getObjects()
            job.position.y=job.position.y+1.75+0.2*job.count
        end)
        if ready then
            -- Taking count-1 cards collapses a deck into its final remainder.
            for i=1,math.max(0,job.count-1) do
                local ok,err=pcall(function()
                    local card=deck.takeObject({position={job.position.x,job.position.y,job.position.z},smooth=false,
                        callback_function=function(c) capture(job,c) end})
                    capture(job,card)
                    local remainder=deck.remainder
                    if remainder then
                        capture(job,remainder)
                        job.position.y=job.position.y-0.2
                        remainder.setPosition({job.position.x,job.position.y,job.position.z})
                        job.finished=true
                    end
                end)
                if not ok then problem=err;break end
                job.position.y=job.position.y-0.2
                coroutine.yield(0)
                if job.finished then break end
            end
            if not problem then wait(2) end
        end
        cleanup(job)
        if problem then broadcastToAll("Deck fix stopped safely: "..tostring(problem),{0.9,0.2,0.2}) end
        return 1
    end
    startLuaCoroutine(self,'spawnAllCards_routine')
end
function findInRadiusBy(pos,radius,filter,debug)
    local hits=Physics.cast({origin=pos,direction={0,1,0},type=2,size={radius or 1,radius or 1,radius or 1},max_distance=0,debug=debug or false})
    local result={}
    for _,hit in ipairs(hits) do if not filter or filter(hit.hit_object) then result[#result+1]=hit.hit_object end end
    return result
end
function wait(seconds)
    local began=os.time()
    repeat coroutine.yield(0) until os.time()>began+seconds
end
function createActivationButton()
    self.clearButtons()
    self.createButton({click_function="click_fixDeck",function_owner=self,position={0,0.1,-0.82},height=150,width=640,color={1,1,1,0},tooltip="Apply fix to deck."})
end

function click_CardAbility()
  local pos = self.getPosition()
	local angle = self.getRotation()
	local forward = 0.65
	local side = 0.0

	local forX= math.sin(math.rad(angle.y))*forward
	local forZ= math.cos(math.rad(angle.y))*forward
	local sideX= math.sin(math.rad(angle.y+90))*side
	local sideZ= math.cos(math.rad(angle.y+90))*side

	TimeToken.takeObject ({
		position = {pos.x-.5-forX-sideX, pos.y+1, pos.z-sideZ-forZ},
		rotation = {angle.x, angle.y, angle.z}
	})

  TimeToken.takeObject ({
    position = {pos.x+.5-forX-sideX, pos.y+1, pos.z-sideZ-forZ}

-- Sync Script --
function click_Sync ()
    local origin = self.getPosition()
    local nearest, bestDistance = nil, 4
    for _, object in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        local supported = object ~= self and object.tag == "Figurine"
        if not supported and object ~= self and object.getTable then
            local ok, memory = pcall(object.getTable, "memory")
            supported = ok and type(memory)=="table" and (memory.role=="base" or memory.role=="baseModel")
        end
        if supported then
            local pos = object.getPosition()
            local distance = (origin.x-pos.x)^2 + (origin.z-pos.z)^2
            if distance <= bestDistance and (not nearest or distance < bestDistance or object.getGUID() < nearest.getGUID()) then
                nearest, bestDistance = object, distance
            end
        end
    end
    if not nearest then print("No ship found; place a ship on this card and retry Sync."); return false end

function findProximity(targetPos, object)
    local objectPos = object.getPosition()
    local xDistance = math.abs(targetPos.x - objectPos.x)
    local zDistance = math.abs(targetPos.z - objectPos.z)
    local distance = xDistance^2 + zDistance^2
    return math.sqrt(distance)
end

local function legacyGuide(mode)
    if mode ~= "clear" and not legacyShip() then return false end
    local ship = myShip

        return Global.call("STA2E_LegacyGuide", {guid=ship and ship.getGUID and ship.getGUID() or nil,
            owner=self.getGUID(), mode=mode})
    end)
    if not ok or result ~= true then print("Measurement unavailable; check the linked ship."); return false end
    return true
end

    local objectPos = object.getPosition()

    })

function click_LoadMap()
        local spos = self.getPosition()
        local nearest = nil
        local minDist = 2.89 -- 80mm
        for k,ship in pairs(getAllObjects()) do
            if ship.tag != 'Generic' then
                local pos = ship.getPosition()
                local dist = math.sqrt(math.pow((spos[1]-pos[1]),2) + math.pow((spos[3]-pos[3]),2))
                if dist < minDist then
                    nearest = ship
                    minDist = dist
                end
            end
        end
        if nearest ~= nil then
            TheBoard = nearest
			TheBoardGUID = TheBoard.getGUID()
        end
		TheBoard = getObjectFromGUID(TheBoardGUID)

		TheBoard = getObjectFromGUID(TheBoardGUID)

--	local myImage = self.getCustomObject()
--	myImage.diffuse =

	local selfParams = TheBoard.getCustomObject()
	selfParams.diffuse = mapURL[1]
	TheBoard.setCustomObject(selfParams)
	newSelf = TheBoard.reload()

end

function click_RotateLeft()

    local angle = newSelf.getRotation()

    newSelf.setRotation({angle.x, angle.y+90, angle.z})
end

end

ObjectStates.Name: Custom_Token
ObjectStates.Nickname: Alliance Act I - A Simple Patrol
ObjectStates.Description: Choose player count, then START. NEXT PHASE uses the normal game phases and deploys due waves. RETRY WAVES retries blocked arrivals. FINISH ends this mission; RESET MISSION removes this mission's generated pieces. Special objective rules are resolved by players.
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
-- Template: replace the two placeholders when embedding in a mission object.
local MISSION_ID="A1M1"
local MISSION_NAME="Act I - A Simple Patrol"
local maxRound=MISSION_ID=="A2M4" and 12 or (MISSION_ID=="A3M1" and 11 or 10)
local players=2
local influence=0
local round=0
local phase="Not started"
local waveText="No waves deployed"
local lastStatus="Choose players, then start this mission."
local pollHandle=nil
local buttonIndex={}

local function wrapped(value,width,maxLines)
    local lines,line={},""
    for word in tostring(value):gmatch("%S+") do
        if line~="" and #line+#word+1>width then
            lines[#lines+1]=line
            line=word
        else
            line=line=="" and word or line.." "..word
        end
    end
    if line~="" then lines[#lines+1]=line end
    if #lines>maxLines then
        while #lines>maxLines do table.remove(lines) end
        lines[maxLines]=lines[maxLines].."..."
    end
    return table.concat(lines,"\n")
end

local function integer(value,minimum,maximum,default)
    local n=tonumber(value)
    if not n then return default end
    return math.max(minimum,math.min(maximum,math.floor(n)))
end

local function message(text,color,isError)
    if type(color)=="string" and color~="" then
        broadcastToColor(text,color,isError and {1,0.35,0.25} or {0.6,0.9,1})
    end
end

local function redraw()
    if not buttonIndex.title then return end
    self.editButton({index=buttonIndex.title,label=wrapped(MISSION_NAME,32,2),tooltip=MISSION_NAME})
    self.editButton({index=buttonIndex.players,label=players.." PLAYERS"})
    if buttonIndex.influence then self.editButton({index=buttonIndex.influence,label="INFLUENCE "..influence}) end
    self.editButton({index=buttonIndex.round,label="ROUND "..tostring(round).." / "..maxRound.."  |  "..tostring(phase)})
    self.editButton({index=buttonIndex.waves,label=wrapped(waveText,48,2),tooltip=tostring(waveText)})
    self.editButton({index=buttonIndex.status,label=wrapped(lastStatus,55,3),tooltip=tostring(lastStatus)})
end

local function applyResponse(result,color,quiet)
    if type(result)~="table" then
        if not quiet then
            lastStatus="Mission runtime returned no response."
            message(lastStatus,color,true)
        end
        redraw()
        return false
    end
    if result.ok==false or result.error then
        lastStatus=tostring(result.error or result.status or "Mission operation failed.")
        if not quiet then message(lastStatus,color,true) end
        redraw()
        return false
    end
    if result.round~=nil then round=result.round end
    if result.phase~=nil then phase=result.phase end
    if result.waveText~=nil then waveText=result.waveText end
    if result.status~=nil then lastStatus=result.status end
    redraw()
    return true
end

local function callRuntime(name,params,color,quiet)
    local ok,result=pcall(function() return Global.call(name,params) end)
    if not ok then
        lastStatus="Runtime error: "..tostring(result)
        if not quiet then message(lastStatus,color,true) end
        redraw()
        return false
    end
    return applyResponse(result,color,quiet)
end

function noAction() end

function choosePlayers()
    players=players+1
    if players>6 then players=2 end
    redraw()
end

function chooseInfluence()
    if MISSION_ID~="A3M1" then return end
    influence=(influence+1)%3
    redraw()
end

function startMission(_,color)
    callRuntime("STA2E_MissionStart",{id=MISSION_ID,playerCount=players,influence=influence,controllerGUID=self.getGUID()},color,false)
end

function advancePhase(_,color)
    callRuntime("STA2E_MissionAdvance",{id=MISSION_ID,color=color},color,false)
end

function retryWaves(_,color)
    callRuntime("STA2E_MissionRetry",{id=MISSION_ID},color,false)
end

function finishMission(_,color)
    callRuntime("STA2E_MissionFinish",{id=MISSION_ID,color=color},color,false)
end

function resetMission(_,color)
    callRuntime("STA2E_MissionReset",{id=MISSION_ID,color=color},color,false)
end

function refreshStatus()
    callRuntime("STA2E_MissionStatus",{id=MISSION_ID},nil,true)
end

-- Optional push callback; polling remains available if Global does not use it.
function onMissionStateChanged(result)
    if type(result)=="table" and (result.id==nil or result.id==MISSION_ID) then applyResponse(result,nil,true) end
end

local function button(key,callback,label,x,z,width,height,fontSize,color,tooltip)
    local existing=self.getButtons() or {}
    buttonIndex[key]=#existing
    self.createButton({click_function=callback,function_owner=self,label=label,
        position={x,0.22,z},rotation={0,0,0},width=width,height=height,font_size=fontSize,
        color=color or {0.13,0.23,0.32,0.98},font_color={1,1,1},tooltip=tooltip or ""})
end

function onLoad(saved)
    local ok,state=pcall(JSON.decode,saved or "")
    if ok and type(state)=="table" then
        players=integer(state.players,2,6,2)
        influence=integer(state.influence,0,2,0)
        lastStatus=type(state.lastStatus)=="string" and state.lastStatus or lastStatus
    end
    self.setLock(true)
    self.clearButtons()
    buttonIndex={}
    button("title","noAction",MISSION_NAME,0,-1.65,0,0,105,nil,"Standalone mission setup and wave controller")
    button("players","choosePlayers","",MISSION_ID=="A3M1" and -0.82 or 0,-1.08,760,265,125,nil,"Cycles 2-6 players for the next setup. Solo play uses two ships and 2-player setup.")
    if MISSION_ID=="A3M1" then
        button("influence","chooseInfluence","",0.82,-1.08,760,265,115,{0.35,0.24,0.12,0.98},"Cycles 0-2 Influence for the next finale setup.")
    end
    button("start","startMission","START",-1.05,-0.53,680,280,125,{0.18,0.46,0.28,0.98},"Build this mission's objects and setup formations.")
    button("advance","advancePhase","NEXT PHASE",0.85,-0.53,1000,280,120,{0.16,0.36,0.55,0.98},"Advance Planning, Activation, Combat, then End phase. Follow the shown phase when resolving manual rules.")
    button("retry","retryWaves","RETRY WAVES",-0.88,0.02,900,260,105,{0.33,0.28,0.12,0.98},"Retry scheduled ships that could not be spawned. Already spawned ships are not duplicated.")
    button("finish","finishMission","FINISH",0.96,0.02,650,260,115,{0.33,0.22,0.40,0.98},"End this mission after manually resolving its objectives and XP.")
    button("reset","resetMission","RESET MISSION",0,0.57,1250,260,110,{0.47,0.19,0.16,0.98},"Reset this mission's runtime and generated mission objects.")
    button("round","noAction","",0,1.10,0,0,110)
    button("waves","noAction","",0,1.48,0,0,75)
    button("status","noAction","",0,1.95,0,0,65)
    redraw()
    refreshStatus()
    if pollHandle then Wait.stop(pollHandle) end
    pollHandle=Wait.time(refreshStatus,2,-1)
end

function onSave()
    return JSON.encode({players=players,influence=influence,lastStatus=lastStatus})
end

function onDestroy()
    if pollHandle then Wait.stop(pollHandle) end

-- Point-board state v2. Descriptions remain user-editable; state is stored as JSON.
local boardSaved = nil
local limits = {Elite=6,Skill=15,Crew=10,Weapon=10,Tech=10}
local slotIndex = {None=0,Crew=1,Weapon=2,Tech=3}
local categories = {"Elite","Skill","Crew","Weapon","Tech"}
local positions = {
    Elite={"114 -55 -2","114 -55 -22","46 -55 -22","26 -55 -22","-60 -55 -22","-78 -55 -22","-96 -55 -22"},
    Skill={114,96,78,61,46,28,9,-9,-27,-45,-60,-78,-96,-114,-132,-141},
    Crew={104,82,58,33,8,-14,-40,-62,-85,-110,-134},
    Weapon={104,82,58,33,8,-14,-40,-62,-85,-110,-134},
    Tech={104,82,58,33,8,-14,-40,-62,-85,-110,-134}
}
local marker = {Elite="E0",Skill="S0",Crew="C0",Weapon="W0",Tech="T0"}
local row = {Skill=-30,Crew=32,Weapon=58,Tech=83}
ExpansionOne, ExpansionTwo = "None", "None"
totalPoints = 0

local function bounded(value, maximum)
    local number=tonumber(value)
    if not number or number~=number or number==math.huge or number==-math.huge then return 0 end
    return math.max(0,math.min(maximum,math.floor(number)))
end
local function decode(saved)
    if type(saved)~="string" or saved=="" then return nil end
    local ok,value=pcall(JSON.decode,saved)
    if ok and type(value)=="table" and value.version==2 then return value end
    return nil
end
local function legacyState()
    local text=self.getDescription() or ""
    -- Read the last five fields so legacy names may contain commas or be empty.
    local name,e,s,c,w,t=text:match("^(.*),([^,]*),([^,]*),([^,]*),([^,]*),([^,]*)$")
    return {name=name or self.getName() or "Name",Elite=e,Skill=s,Crew=c,Weapon=w,Tech=t}
end
local function render()
    totalPoints=0
    for _,category in ipairs(categories) do
        local value=bounded(_G[category.."Points"],limits[category])
        _G[category.."Points"]=value
        totalPoints=totalPoints+value
        local position=positions[category][value+1]
        if category~="Elite" then position=tostring(position).." "..row[category].." -22" end
        self.UI.setAttribute(marker[category],"position",position)
    end
    self.UI.setAttribute("Name","text",self.getName())
    self.UI.setAttribute("Cost","text",tostring(totalPoints))
    self.UI.setAttribute("ExpansionOne","value",tostring(slotIndex[ExpansionOne] or 0))
    self.UI.setAttribute("ExpansionTwo","value",tostring(slotIndex[ExpansionTwo] or 0))
end
function SaveState()
    local state={version=2,name=self.getName(),ExpansionOne=ExpansionOne,ExpansionTwo=ExpansionTwo}
    for _,category in ipairs(categories) do state[category]=bounded(_G[category.."Points"],limits[category]) end
    boardSaved=JSON.encode(state)
    self.script_state=boardSaved
    return boardSaved
end
function LoadState()
    local state=decode(boardSaved) or legacyState()
    self.setName(type(state.name)=="string" and state.name or "Name")
    for _,category in ipairs(categories) do _G[category.."Points"]=bounded(state[category],limits[category]) end
    ExpansionOne=slotIndex[state.ExpansionOne] and state.ExpansionOne or "None"
    ExpansionTwo=slotIndex[state.ExpansionTwo] and state.ExpansionTwo or "None"
    render()
    SaveState()
end
function onLoad(saved)
    boardSaved=saved
    self.clearContextMenu()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Load",LoadState)
    LoadState()
end
function onSave() return SaveState() end
function nameUpdate(player,value)
    self.setName(tostring(value or ""))
    render(); SaveState()
end
local function adjust(category,amount)
    _G[category.."Points"]=bounded((_G[category.."Points"] or 0)+amount,limits[category])
    render(); SaveState()
end
function EliteUp() adjust("Elite",1) end
function EliteDown() adjust("Elite",-1) end
function SkillUp() adjust("Skill",1) end
function SkillDown() adjust("Skill",-1) end
function CrewUp() adjust("Crew",1) end
function CrewDown() adjust("Crew",-1) end
function WeaponUp() adjust("Weapon",1) end
function WeaponDown() adjust("Weapon",-1) end
function TechUp() adjust("Tech",1) end
function TechDown() adjust("Tech",-1) end
-- Expansion controls record the two additional slot types; they do not alter costs.
function option1Selected(player,value)
    if slotIndex[value]==nil then return end
    ExpansionOne=value; render(); SaveState()
end
function option2Selected(player,value)
    if slotIndex[value]==nil then return end
    ExpansionTwo=value; render(); SaveState()
end

ObjectStates.LuaScript:
-- Standard two-player setup guides. This controller owns its own vector lines;
-- the playmat, ship arcs/ranges, and Alliance mission guides are never edited.
local BOARD_GUID="ae9c49"
local PLAY_AREA_HALF=18.1 -- visible mat perimeter, reduced from 18.8
local active=false
local loadGeneration=0
local RED={0.95,0.20,0.18}
local BLUE={0.12,0.62,1.0}
local GOLD={1.0,0.78,0.16}

local function component(v,key,index,default)
    return tonumber(v and (v[key] or v[index])) or default
end

local function boardFrame()
    local board=getObjectFromGUID(BOARD_GUID)
    if not board then return nil end
    local p,r,s=board.getPosition(),board.getRotation(),board.getScale()
    -- Match the visible play surface; keep the 4/8-inch insets in world units.
    -- TTS world units are inches; Range 1 is 3.94 because it represents 10 cm.
    return {x=component(p,"x",1,0),y=Global.call("STA2E_GuidePlane"),
        z=component(p,"z",3,0),yaw=component(r,"y",2,90)-90,
        -- Book/frame x follows the model's local z axis at its normal 90 yaw.
        halfX=PLAY_AREA_HALF*math.abs(component(s,"z",3,1.89))/1.89,
        halfZ=PLAY_AREA_HALF*math.abs(component(s,"x",1,1.89))/1.89}
end

local function worldPoint(frame,x,z)
    local angle=math.rad(frame.yaw)
    return {x=frame.x+x*math.cos(angle)+z*math.sin(angle),y=frame.y,
        z=frame.z-x*math.sin(angle)+z*math.cos(angle)}
end

local function polygon(frame,points,color)
    local result={points={},color=color,thickness=0.06}
    for _,point in ipairs(points) do
        local localPoint=self.positionToLocal(worldPoint(frame,point[1],point[2]))
        result.points[#result.points+1]={localPoint.x or localPoint[1],localPoint.y or localPoint[2],localPoint.z or localPoint[3]}
    end
    return result
end

local function drawGuides()
    local frame=boardFrame()
    if not frame or frame.halfX<=8 or frame.halfZ<=8 then return false end
    local x,z=frame.halfX,frame.halfZ
    self.setVectorLines({
        polygon(frame,{{-x,-z},{x,-z},{x,-z+4},{-x,-z+4},{-x,-z}},RED),
        polygon(frame,{{-x,z},{x,z},{x,z-4},{-x,z-4},{-x,z}},BLUE),
        polygon(frame,{{-x+8,-z+8},{x-8,-z+8},{x-8,z-8},{-x+8,z-8},{-x+8,-z+8}},GOLD)
    })
    return true
end

local function redrawButton()
    self.editButton({index=1,label=active and "HIDE SETUP LINES" or "2 PLAYER SETUP",
        color=active and {0.25,0.41,0.23,1} or {0.13,0.32,0.47,1}})
end

function noAction() end

function clearSetup()
    active=false
    loadGeneration=loadGeneration+1
    self.setVectorLines({})
    redrawButton()
end

function toggleSetup(_,color)
    if active then clearSetup();return end
    if drawGuides() then
        active=true
        redrawButton()
    elseif type(color)=="string" and color~="" then
        broadcastToColor("Standard setup needs the playmat on the table at its normal size.",color,{1,0.65,0.2})
    end
end

function onObjectDrop(_,object)
    if not active or not object or not object.getGUID then return end
    if object==self or object.getGUID()==BOARD_GUID then drawGuides() end
end

function onLoad(saved)
    local ok,state=pcall(JSON.decode,saved or "")
    active=ok and type(state)=="table" and state.active==true or false
    loadGeneration=loadGeneration+1
    local generation=loadGeneration
    self.setLock(true)

local players=2

local round=0
local phase="Not started"
local waveText="No waves deployed"
local lastStatus="Choose players, then start this mission."
local pollHandle=nil
local buttonIndex={}

local function wrapped(value,width,maxLines)
    local lines,line={},""
    for word in tostring(value):gmatch("%S+") do
        if line~="" and #line+#word+1>width then
            lines[#lines+1]=line
            line=word
        else
            line=line=="" and word or line.." "..word
        end
    end
    if line~="" then lines[#lines+1]=line end
    if #lines>maxLines then
        while #lines>maxLines do table.remove(lines) end
        lines[maxLines]=lines[maxLines].."..."
    end
    return table.concat(lines,"\n")
end

local function integer(value,minimum,maximum,default)
    local n=tonumber(value)
    if not n then return default end
    return math.max(minimum,math.min(maximum,math.floor(n)))
end

local function message(text,color,isError)
    if type(color)=="string" and color~="" then
        broadcastToColor(text,color,isError and {1,0.35,0.25} or {0.6,0.9,1})
    end
end

local function redraw()
    if not buttonIndex.title then return end
    self.editButton({index=buttonIndex.title,label=wrapped(MISSION_NAME,32,2),tooltip=MISSION_NAME})
    self.editButton({index=buttonIndex.players,label=players.." PLAYERS"})
    if buttonIndex.difficulty then self.editButton({index=buttonIndex.difficulty,label=string.upper(difficulty)}) end
    if buttonIndex.influence then self.editButton({index=buttonIndex.influence,label="INFLUENCE "..influence}) end
    self.editButton({index=buttonIndex.round,label="ROUND "..tostring(round).." / "..maxRound.."  |  "..tostring(phase)})

        redraw()
        return false
    end
    if result.ok==false or result.error then
        lastStatus=tostring(result.error or result.status or "Mission operation failed.")
        if not quiet then message(lastStatus,color,true) end
        redraw()
        return false
    end
    if result.round~=nil then round=result.round end

    redraw()

        return false

end

    callRuntime("STA2E_MissionFinish",{id=MISSION_ID,color=color},color,false)
end

    callRuntime("STA2E_MissionReset",{id=MISSION_ID,color=color},color,false)

end

    button("reset","resetMission","RESET MISSION",0,0.57,1250,260,110,{0.47,0.19,0.16,0.98},"Reset this mission's runtime and generated mission objects.")
    button("round","noAction","",0,1.10,0,0,110)

-- Template: replace the two placeholders when embedding in a mission object.
local MISSION_ID="A6M2"
local MISSION_NAME="Act VI - Invasion of Betazed (Finale)"
local maxRound=10
local difficulty="normal"
local players=2
local influence=0
local round=0
local phase="Not started"
local waveText="No waves deployed"
local lastStatus="Choose players, then start this mission."
local pollHandle=nil
local buttonIndex={}

local function wrapped(value,width,maxLines)
    local lines,line={},""
    for word in tostring(value):gmatch("%S+") do
        if line~="" and #line+#word+1>width then
            lines[#lines+1]=line
            line=word
        else
            line=line=="" and word or line.." "..word
        end
    end
    if line~="" then lines[#lines+1]=line end
    if #lines>maxLines then
        while #lines>maxLines do table.remove(lines) end
        lines[maxLines]=lines[maxLines].."..."
    end
    return table.concat(lines,"\n")
end

local function integer(value,minimum,maximum,default)
    local n=tonumber(value)
    if not n then return default end
    return math.max(minimum,math.min(maximum,math.floor(n)))
end

local function message(text,color,isError)
    if type(color)=="string" and color~="" then
        broadcastToColor(text,color,isError and {1,0.35,0.25} or {0.6,0.9,1})
    end
end

local function redraw()
    if not buttonIndex.title then return end
    self.editButton({index=buttonIndex.title,label=wrapped(MISSION_NAME,32,2),tooltip=MISSION_NAME})
    self.editButton({index=buttonIndex.players,label=players.." PLAYERS"})
    if buttonIndex.difficulty then self.editButton({index=buttonIndex.difficulty,label=string.upper(difficulty)}) end
    if buttonIndex.influence then self.editButton({index=buttonIndex.influence,label="INFLUENCE "..influence}) end
    self.editButton({index=buttonIndex.round,label="ROUND "..tostring(round).." / "..maxRound.."  |  "..tostring(phase)})
    self.editButton({index=buttonIndex.waves,label=wrapped(waveText,48,2),tooltip=tostring(waveText)})
    self.editButton({index=buttonIndex.status,label=wrapped(lastStatus,55,3),tooltip=tostring(lastStatus)})
end

local function applyResponse(result,color,quiet)
    if type(result)~="table" then
        if not quiet then
            lastStatus="Mission runtime returned no response."
            message(lastStatus,color,true)
        end
        redraw()
        return false
    end
    if result.ok==false or result.error then
        lastStatus=tostring(result.error or result.status or "Mission operation failed.")
        if not quiet then message(lastStatus,color,true) end
        redraw()
        return false
    end
    if result.round~=nil then round=result.round end
    if result.phase~=nil then phase=result.phase end
    if result.waveText~=nil then waveText=result.waveText end
    if result.status~=nil then lastStatus=result.status end
    redraw()
    return true
end

local function callRuntime(name,params,color,quiet)
    local ok,result=pcall(function() return Global.call(name,params) end)
    if not ok then
        lastStatus="Runtime error: "..tostring(result)
        if not quiet then message(lastStatus,color,true) end
        redraw()
        return false
    end
    return applyResponse(result,color,quiet)
end

function noAction() end

function choosePlayers()
    players=players+1
    if players>6 then players=2 end
    redraw()
end

function chooseInfluence()
    if MISSION_ID~="A6M2" then return end
    influence=(influence+1)%3
    redraw()
end

function chooseDifficulty()
    difficulty=difficulty=="normal" and "adjusted" or "normal"
    redraw()
end

function startMission(_,color)
    callRuntime("STA2E_MissionStart",{id=MISSION_ID,playerCount=players,influence=influence,difficulty=difficulty,controllerGUID=self.getGUID()},color,false)
end

function advancePhase(_,color)
    callRuntime("STA2E_MissionAdvance",{id=MISSION_ID,color=color},color,false)
end

function retryWaves(_,color)
    callRuntime("STA2E_MissionRetry",{id=MISSION_ID},color,false)
end

function finishMission(_,color)
    callRuntime("STA2E_MissionFinish",{id=MISSION_ID,color=color},color,false)
end

function resetMission(_,color)
    callRuntime("STA2E_MissionReset",{id=MISSION_ID,color=color},color,false)
end

function refreshStatus()
    callRuntime("STA2E_MissionStatus",{id=MISSION_ID},nil,true)
end

-- Optional push callback; polling remains available if Global does not use it.
function onMissionStateChanged(result)
    if type(result)=="table" and (result.id==nil or result.id==MISSION_ID) then applyResponse(result,nil,true) end
end

local function button(key,callback,label,x,z,width,height,fontSize,color,tooltip)
    local existing=self.getButtons() or {}
    buttonIndex[key]=#existing
    self.createButton({click_function=callback,function_owner=self,label=label,
        position={x,0.22,z},rotation={0,0,0},width=width,height=height,font_size=fontSize,
        color=color or {0.13,0.23,0.32,0.98},font_color={1,1,1},tooltip=tooltip or ""})
end

function onLoad(saved)
    local ok,state=pcall(JSON.decode,saved or "")
    if ok and type(state)=="table" then
        players=integer(state.players,2,6,2)
        influence=integer(state.influence,0,2,0)
        difficulty=state.difficulty=="adjusted" and "adjusted" or "normal"
        lastStatus=type(state.lastStatus)=="string" and state.lastStatus or lastStatus
    end
    self.setLock(true)
    self.clearButtons()
    buttonIndex={}
    button("title","noAction",MISSION_NAME,0,-1.65,0,0,105,nil,"Standalone mission setup and wave controller")
    button("players","choosePlayers","",MISSION_ID=="A6M2" and -0.82 or 0,-1.08,760,265,125,nil,"Cycles 2-6 players for the next setup. Solo play uses two ships and 2-player setup.")
    if MISSION_ID=="A6M2" then
        button("influence","chooseInfluence","",0.82,-1.08,760,265,115,{0.35,0.24,0.12,0.98},"Cycles 0-2 Influence for the next finale setup.")
    end
    button("difficulty","chooseDifficulty","",0,-2.12,1100,260,110,nil,"Normal or printed Adjusted difficulty for the next mission. The active mission retains its starting setting.")
    button("start","startMission","START",-1.05,-0.53,680,280,125,{0.18,0.46,0.28,0.98},"Build this mission's objects and setup formations.")
    button("advance","advancePhase","NEXT PHASE",0.85,-0.53,1000,280,120,{0.16,0.36,0.55,0.98},"Advance Planning, Activation, Combat, then End phase. Follow the shown phase when resolving manual rules.")
    button("retry","retryWaves","RETRY WAVES",-0.88,0.02,900,260,105,{0.33,0.28,0.12,0.98},"Retry scheduled ships that could not be spawned. Already spawned ships are not duplicated.")
    button("finish","finishMission","FINISH",0.96,0.02,650,260,115,{0.33,0.22,0.40,0.98},"End this mission after manually resolving its objectives and XP.")
    button("reset","resetMission","RESET MISSION",0,0.57,1250,260,110,{0.47,0.19,0.16,0.98},"Reset this mission's runtime and generated mission objects.")
    button("round","noAction","",0,1.10,0,0,110)
    button("waves","noAction","",0,1.48,0,0,75)
    button("status","noAction","",0,1.95,0,0,65)
    redraw()
    refreshStatus()
    if pollHandle then Wait.stop(pollHandle) end
    pollHandle=Wait.time(refreshStatus,2,-1)
end

function onSave()
    return JSON.encode({players=players,influence=influence,difficulty=difficulty,lastStatus=lastStatus})
end

    if pollHandle then Wait.stop(pollHandle) end
end

local MISSION_ID='A7M1'
local MISSION_NAME='Act VII - Liberation of Benzar (Introduction)'
local maxRound=10
local players,difficulty=2,'normal'
local prior={penumbra=false,supplyRun=false,dogsRound=7}
local factions={'romulan','romulan','romulan','romulan','romulan','romulan'}
local asteroid=1
local status={round=0,phase='Not started',waveText='No waves deployed',status='Choose settings, then START.'}

local redraw
local function wrapped(value,width,maxLines)
    local lines,line={},''
    for word in tostring(value):gmatch('%S+') do
        if line~='' and #line+#word+1>width then lines[#lines+1]=line;line=word else line=line=='' and word or line..' '..word end
    end

ObjectStates.Name: Custom_Model
ObjectStates.Description: Choose 1–12 dice. Roll Attack or Defense. Controls and spawn positions follow this box when it is moved, rotated or resized.
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
-- Controls belong to the supplied dice-box mesh. Normalize their scale so a
-- non-uniformly scaled or rotated box does not stretch or overlap the buttons.
memory={count=3,dice={}}
local epoch=0
local layout
local function geometry()
 local b=self.getBoundsNormalized();local s=self.getScale();local p=self.getPosition()
 local sx,sy,sz=math.max(0.001,math.abs(s.x)),math.max(0.001,math.abs(s.y)),math.max(0.001,math.abs(s.z))
 local offset=b.offset or {x=0,y=0,z=0}
 local cy=(offset.y or ((b.center and b.center.y or p.y)-p.y))
 return {w=math.max(2,b.size.x-0.5),d=math.max(2,b.size.z-0.5),
  cx=(offset.x or 0)/sx,cz=(offset.z or 0)/sz,
  -- The supplied tray's cached mesh spans Y -0.555..0.555; its inner floor
  -- is Y -0.15. Use that proportion, then lift the controls 0.025 world units.
  y=(cy-b.size.y*(0.15/1.11)+0.025)/sy,sx=sx,sy=sy,sz=sz}
end
function redraw()
 self.clearButtons();layout=geometry();local a=layout
 local h=math.min(0.56,a.d*0.12)
 local function b(fn,label,x,z,w,height)
  self.createButton({function_owner=self,click_function=fn,label=label,
   position={a.cx+x/a.sx,a.y,a.cz+z/a.sz},rotation={0,0,0},scale={1/a.sx,1/a.sy,1/a.sz},
   width=math.floor(w*500),height=math.floor((height or h)*500),font_size=math.floor(h*210),
   color={0.12,0.28,0.42,1},font_color={1,1,1}})
 end
 b("less","−",-a.w*0.35,-a.d*0.34,a.w*0.16)
 b("noop",tostring(memory.count).." DICE",0,-a.d*0.34,a.w*0.42)
 b("more","+",a.w*0.35,-a.d*0.34,a.w*0.16)
 b("attack","ROLL ATTACK",-a.w*0.25,a.d*0.23,a.w*0.44)
 b("defense","ROLL DEFENSE",a.w*0.25,a.d*0.23,a.w*0.44)
 b("clear","CLEAR",0,a.d*0.42,a.w*0.38,h*0.8)
end
function onLoad(saved)
 local ok,v=pcall(JSON.decode,saved or "")
 if ok and type(v)=="table" then memory=v end
 memory.count=math.max(1,math.min(12,tonumber(memory.count) or 3));memory.dice=memory.dice or {}
 redraw()
end
function onSave()return JSON.encode(memory)end
function noop()end
function less()memory.count=math.max(1,memory.count-1);redraw()end
function more()memory.count=math.min(12,memory.count+1);redraw()end
function clear()
 epoch=epoch+1
 for _,guid in ipairs(memory.dice)do local die=getObjectFromGUID(guid);if die and die.getGMNotes()=="STA2E_ROLLER|"..self.getGUID() then die.destruct()end end
 memory.dice={}
end
local function roll(guid,color)
 local bag=getObjectFromGUID(guid)
 if not bag then broadcastToColor("This dice supply is missing.",color,{1,0.5,0.3});return end
 clear();local ticket=epoch;local a=geometry()
 local columns=math.min(6,math.max(2,math.floor(a.w/0.8)))
 local rows=math.ceil(memory.count/columns)
 for i=1,memory.count do
  local x=(((i-1)%columns)-(math.min(columns,memory.count)-1)/2)*(a.w*0.70/columns)
  local z=(math.floor((i-1)/columns)-(rows-1)/2)*(a.d*0.32/math.max(1,rows))
  local localPoint={x=a.cx+x/a.sx,y=a.y+1.8/a.sy,z=a.cz+z/a.sz}
  local position=self.positionToWorld(localPoint)
  bag.takeObject({position=position,rotation={math.random(0,359),math.random(0,359),math.random(0,359)},callback_function=function(die)
   if not die then return end
   if ticket~=epoch then die.destruct();return end
   die.setGMNotes("STA2E_ROLLER|"..self.getGUID());memory.dice[#memory.dice+1]=die.getGUID()
   Wait.frames(function()if ticket==epoch and getObjectFromGUID(die.getGUID())then die.randomize()end end,2)
  end})
 end
end
function attack(_,color)roll("00e112",color)end
function defense(_,color)roll("fd1d2b",color)end
function onObjectDrop(_,object)if object==self then redraw()end end
